explain.th: ประโยคที่ 2: ไปดูการสร้างทางรถไฟทุกวัน

quiz.ja: 最初にトロッコを押した時、だれが良平たちをしかりましたか。

explain.en: Sentences 22–23: a tall worker in an old coat scolded them.
explain.zh-Hans: 第22–23句：穿旧号衣的高个子土工训斥了他们。
explain.zh-Hant: 第22–23句：穿舊號衣的高個子土工訓斥了他們。
explain.tl: Pangungusap 22–23: pinagalitan sila ng matangkad na trabahador.
explain.pt: Frases 22–23: um operário alto os repreendeu.
explain.my: ဝါကျ ၂၂–၂၃: အရပ်ရှည် အလုပ်သမားက ဆူတယ်။
explain.th: ประโยคที่ 22–23: คนงานตัวสูงดุพวกเขา
explain.si: වාක්‍ය 22–23: පරණ කබායක් ඇඳපු උස කම්කරුවෙක් බැන්නා.

jaFurigana.surface: たちをしかりましたか。

explain.en: Sentences 39–40: when he saw the sea, he realized he'd come far.
explain.zh-Hans: 第39–40句：看到大海时，他发觉走得太远了。
explain.zh-Hant: 第39–40句：看到大海時，他發覺走得太遠了。
explain.tl: Pangungusap 39–40: nang makita ang dagat, napagtanto niyang malayo na siya.
explain.ne: वाक्य ३९–४०: समुद्र देख्दा टाढा आइपुगेको थाहा भयो।
explain.id: Kalimat 39–40: saat melihat laut, ia sadar sudah jauh.
explain.pt: Frases 39–40: ao ver o mar, percebeu que fora longe.
explain.th: ประโยคที่ 39–40: เห็นทะเลแล้วรู้ตัวว่ามาไกล
explain.si: වාක්‍ය 39–40: මුහුද පෙනුණාම, ගොඩක් ඈතට ආවා කියලා තේරුණා.

explain.en: Sentence 50: because they were staying over there that night.
explain.zh-Hans: 第50句：因为他们今天要在那边住。
explain.zh-Hant: 第50句：因為他們今天要在那邊住。
explain.ne: वाक्य ५०: उनीहरू आज उतै बस्ने भएकाले।
explain.id: Kalimat 50: karena mereka menginap di sana hari itu.
explain.pt: Frase 50: porque iam dormir lá adiante.
explain.th: ประโยคที่ 50: เพราะวันนี้พวกเขาจะค้างที่โน่น
explain.si: වාක්‍ය 50: ඒ රෑ එයාලා එහේ නවතින නිසා.

choicesFurigana.surface: トロッコがこわれたから

explain.my: ဝါကျ ၆၂: အသံကျယ်ကျယ်နဲ့ ငိုချ။
explain.th: ประโยคที่ 62: ร้องไห้โฮออกมา

sentences.ja: 小田原と熱海の間に、小さな鉄道を作る工事が始まったのは、良平が八つの年でした。
sentences.romaji: Odawara to atami no aida ni, chiisana tetsudou o tsukuru kouji ga hajimatta no wa, Ryouhei ga yattsu no toshi deshita.

translations.vi: Năm Ryōhei lên tám, người ta bắt đầu làm một tuyến đường sắt nhỏ giữa Odawara và Atami.
translations.en: It was the year Ryōhei turned eight that work began on a small railway between Odawara and Atami.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平八岁那年，小田原和热海之间开始修建一条小铁路。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平八歲那年，小田原和熱海之間開始修建一條小鐵路。
translations.ko: 오다와라와 아타미 사이에 작은 철도를 놓는 공사가 시작된 것은 료헤이가 여덟 살 때였습니다.
translations.tl: Walong taon si Ryōhei nang simulan ang paggawa ng maliit na riles sa pagitan ng Odawara at Atami.
translations.ne: ओदावारा र आतामीबीच सानो रेलमार्ग बनाउने काम सुरु हुँदा र्योहेई आठ वर्षको थियो।
translations.id: Pembangunan rel kecil antara Odawara dan Atami dimulai saat Ryōhei berumur delapan tahun.
translations.pt: Foi no ano em que Ryōhei fez oito anos que começou a obra de uma pequena ferrovia entre Odawara e Atami.
translations.my: ဩဒါဝါရနဲ့ အာတာမီကြား ရထားလမ်းငယ် ဆောက်တာ စတုန်းက ရျိုဟေး ရှစ်နှစ်ရှိပြီ။
translations.th: ปีที่เรียวเฮอายุแปดขวบ เริ่มมีการสร้างทางรถไฟเล็กๆ ระหว่างโอดาวาระกับอาตามิ
translations.si: ඕදවාරා සහ අතමි අතර, කුඩා දුම්රිය මාර්ගයක් තැනීමේ වැඩ ආරම්භ වූයේ, රියෝහෙයිට වයස අවුරුදු අටේදීය.

meanings.my: ဆောက်လုပ်ရေး
meanings.th: งานก่อสร้าง

grammarNote.my: 〜のは〜でした = ~ တာက ~ ပါ။
grammarNote.th: 〜のは〜でした = ที่ ~ คือ ~

sentences.ja: 良平は、毎日村はずれへ、その工事を見に行きました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, mainichi murahazure e, sono kouji o mi ni ikimashita.

translations.vi: Ngày nào Ryōhei cũng ra đầu làng xem người ta làm việc.
translations.en: Every day, Ryōhei went to the edge of the village to watch the work.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平每天都到村口去看施工。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平每天都到村口去看施工。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 날마다 마을 어귀로 그 공사를 보러 갔습니다.
translations.tl: Araw-araw, pumupunta si Ryōhei sa dulo ng nayon upang manood ng gawain.
translations.ne: र्योहेई हरेक दिन गाउँको छेउमा त्यो काम हेर्न जान्थ्यो।
translations.id: Setiap hari Ryōhei pergi ke ujung desa untuk melihat pekerjaan itu.
translations.pt: Todos os dias, Ryōhei ia à saída da vila ver a obra.
translations.th: ทุกวันเรียวเฮจะไปที่ชายหมู่บ้านเพื่อดูงานนั้น
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, හැමදාම ගම් මායිමට, ඒ වැඩ බලන්නට ගියේය.

grammarNote.vi: 村はずれ = rìa làng, đầu làng.
grammarNote.en: 村はずれ = outskirts of the village.
grammarNote.tl: 村はずれ = dulo ng nayon.
grammarNote.pt: 村はずれ = saída da vila.
grammarNote.my: 村はずれ = ရွာစွန်။
grammarNote.th: 村はずれ = ชายหมู่บ้าน

sentences.ja: 工事といっても、トロッコで土を運ぶだけの仕事です。

furigana.surface: といっても、トロッコで

sentences.romaji: Kouji to itte mo, torokko de tsuchi o hakobu dake no shigoto desu.

translations.vi: Gọi là công trình, nhưng thực ra chỉ là dùng xe goòng chở đất.
translations.en: Though called construction, it was only the job of hauling earth in trolleys.
translations.zh-Hans: 说是施工，其实只是用小矿车运土的活儿。
translations.zh-Hant: 說是施工，其實只是用小礦車運土的活兒。
translations.ko: 공사라고 해도 토롯코로 흙을 나르는 일뿐입니다.
translations.tl: Bagama't tinatawag na konstruksiyon, pagdadala lang ito ng lupa gamit ang trolley.
translations.ne: काम भने पनि ट्रलीमा माटो बोक्ने मात्र काम थियो।
translations.id: Meski disebut pembangunan, itu hanya pekerjaan mengangkut tanah dengan lori.
translations.pt: Embora se chamasse obra, era só levar terra em vagonetes.
translations.th: ว่ากันว่าเป็นงานก่อสร้าง แต่ก็แค่ขนดินด้วยรถลากรางเท่านั้น
translations.si: ඉදිකිරීම් කිව්වත්, එය ට්‍රොලිවලින් පස් ප්‍රවාහනය කරන වැඩක් පමණි.

grammarNote.my: 〜といっても = ~ ဆိုပေမဲ့။
grammarNote.th: 〜といっても = ถึงจะว่า ~ ก็ตาม

sentences.ja: 土を積んだトロッコの上には、男が二人、後ろに乗っています。
sentences.romaji: Tsuchi o tsunda torokko no ue ni wa, otoko ga futari, ushiro ni notteimasu.

translations.vi: Phía sau mỗi chiếc goòng chất đầy đất có hai người đàn ông đứng.
translations.en: On the back of each trolley loaded with earth rode two men.
translations.zh-Hans: 装满土的小矿车后面，站着两个男人。
translations.zh-Hant: 裝滿土的小礦車後面，站著兩個男人。
translations.ko: 흙을 실은 토롯코 뒤에는 남자 두 명이 타고 있습니다.
translations.tl: Sa likod ng bawat trolley na puno ng lupa, nakasakay ang dalawang lalaki.
translations.ne: माटो लादेको ट्रलीको पछाडि दुई जना मान्छे चढेका हुन्थे।
translations.id: Di belakang lori bermuatan tanah, ada dua pria yang menumpang.
translations.pt: Na traseira de cada vagonete cheio de terra iam dois homens.
translations.th: ด้านหลังรถลากที่บรรทุกดิน มีผู้ชายสองคนยืนอยู่
translations.si: පස් පටවා ඇති ට්‍රොලිය මත, පිටුපසින් මිනිසුන් දෙදෙනෙක් නැගී සිටිති.

grammarNote.my: 積む = တင်။
grammarNote.th: 積む = บรรทุก

sentences.ja: トロッコは山を下るので、人の手を借りなくても、ひとりでに走ってきます。

furigana.surface: りなくても、ひとりでに

sentences.romaji: Torokko wa yama o kudaru node, hito no te o karinakute mo, hitorideni hashittekimasu.

translations.vi: Vì goòng đổ dốc xuống núi nên chẳng cần ai đẩy, nó tự lao xuống.
translations.en: Since the trolley went downhill, it ran by itself without anyone's help.
translations.zh-Hans: 因为小矿车是下山，所以不用人推，自己就跑了下来。
translations.zh-Hant: 因為小礦車是下山，所以不用人推，自己就跑了下來。
translations.ko: 토롯코는 산을 내려오기 때문에 사람 손을 빌리지 않아도 저절로 달려옵니다.
translations.tl: Dahil pababa ng bundok, kusang tumatakbo ang trolley nang walang tumutulak.
translations.ne: ट्रली पहाड ओरालो झर्ने भएकाले कसैले नधकेले पनि आफैं दौडिन्थ्यो।
translations.id: Karena menuruni gunung, lori itu meluncur sendiri tanpa didorong orang.
translations.pt: Como descia a montanha, o vagonete corria sozinho, sem ajuda de ninguém.
translations.my: ထော်လီက တောင်အောက်ဆင်းတာမို့ ဘယ်သူမှ မတွန်းလည်း သူ့အလိုလို ပြေးလာတယ်။
translations.th: เพราะรถลากไหลลงเขา จึงวิ่งลงมาเองโดยไม่ต้องมีใครเข็น
translations.si: ට්‍රොලිය කන්දෙන් පහළට යන නිසා, කිසිවෙකුගේ උදව්වක් නැතිවම, ඉබේම දුවගෙන එයි.

meanings.my: သူ့အလိုလို

grammarNote.vi: ひとりでに = tự nó, tự động.
grammarNote.my: ひとりでに = သူ့အလိုလို။
grammarNote.th: ひとりでに = เอง

sentences.ja: 男たちの服のすそがひらひらと風にゆれ、細い線路が曲がりくねっていました。

furigana.surface: がりくねっていました。

sentences.romaji: Otokotachi no fuku no suso ga hirahira to kaze ni yure, hosoi senro ga magarikunetteimashita.

translations.vi: Vạt áo của những người đàn ông phấp phới trong gió, đường ray mảnh uốn lượn.
translations.en: The hems of the men's clothes fluttered in the wind, and the thin rails twisted and wound.
translations.zh-Hans: 男人们的衣摆在风中飘动，细细的铁轨弯弯曲曲。
translations.zh-Hant: 男人們的衣襬在風中飄動，細細的鐵軌彎彎曲曲。
translations.ko: 남자들의 옷자락이 바람에 펄럭이고, 가는 선로가 구불구불 이어졌습니다.
translations.tl: Kumakaway sa hangin ang laylayan ng damit ng mga lalaki, at paliko-liko ang manipis na riles.
translations.ne: मान्छेहरूको लुगाको फेर हावामा फरफराउँथ्यो, पातलो रेलको लिक घुमाउरो थियो।
translations.id: Ujung baju para pria berkibar ditiup angin, dan rel tipis itu berkelok-kelok.
translations.pt: As barras das roupas dos homens esvoaçavam ao vento, e os trilhos finos serpenteavam.
translations.my: လူတွေရဲ့ အဝတ်အနားစတွေ လေထဲ လွင့်နေပြီး သံလမ်းသေးသေးလေး ကွေ့ကောက်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ชายเสื้อของพวกผู้ชายพลิ้วไหวตามลม รางเหล็กเส้นเล็กคดเคี้ยวไปมา
translations.si: මිනිසුන්ගේ ඇඳුම්වල පහළ කොන් සුළඟට ලෙළදෙමින් තිබුණු අතර, සිහින් රේල් පීලි වංගු ගැසී දිව ගියේය.

grammarNote.my: ひらひら = လွင့်လွင့်။
grammarNote.th: ひらひら = พลิ้ว

sentences.ja: 良平は、そんな景色をながめながら、土工になりたいと思いました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, sonna keshiki o nagamenagara, dokou ni naritai to omoimashita.

translations.vi: Ngắm cảnh ấy, Ryōhei ước mình được làm thợ đất.
translations.en: Watching the scene, Ryōhei wished he could become a laborer.
translations.zh-Hans: 看着那样的景象，良平想当一名土工。
translations.zh-Hant: 看著那樣的景象，良平想當一名土工。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 그런 광경을 바라보며 인부가 되고 싶다고 생각했습니다.
translations.tl: Habang pinanonood iyon, ninais ni Ryōhei na maging trabahador.
translations.ne: त्यो दृश्य हेर्दै र्योहेईलाई मजदुर बन्न मन लाग्यो।
translations.id: Sambil memandangi pemandangan itu, Ryōhei ingin menjadi buruh.
translations.pt: Olhando aquilo, Ryōhei desejou ser operário.
translations.my: အဲဒီမြင်ကွင်းကို ကြည့်ရင်း ရျိုဟေး အလုပ်သမား ဖြစ်ချင်လာတယ်။
translations.th: เรียวเฮมองภาพนั้นแล้วอยากเป็นคนงาน
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, ඒ දර්ශනය බලා සිටිමින්, කම්කරුවෙක් වන්නට ආශා කළේය.

grammarNote.vi: 土工 = thợ đất, phu làm đường.
grammarNote.my: 土工 = မြေတူးအလုပ်သမား။
grammarNote.th: 土工 = คนงานดิน

sentences.ja: 「せめて一度でいいから、土工といっしょにトロッコに乗ってみたいなあ。」

furigana.surface: といっしょにトロッコに

sentences.romaji: “Semete ichido deii kara, dokou to issho ni torokko ni nottemitai naa.”

translations.vi: “Chỉ một lần thôi cũng được, mình muốn được ngồi goòng cùng các chú thợ.”
translations.en: "Even just once, I'd love to ride a trolley with the workers."
translations.zh-Hans: “哪怕只有一次也好，真想和土工们一起坐小矿车啊。”
translations.zh-Hant: “哪怕只有一次也好，真想和土工們一起坐小礦車啊。”
translations.ko: “딱 한 번만이라도 좋으니 인부들과 함께 토롯코를 타 보고 싶다.”
translations.tl: "Kahit minsan lang, gusto kong sumakay sa trolley kasama ng mga trabahador."
translations.ne: "एकपटक मात्र भए पनि मजदुरहरूसँग ट्रलीमा चढ्न पाए हुन्थ्यो।"
translations.id: "Sekali saja pun boleh, aku ingin naik lori bersama para buruh."
translations.pt: "Nem que fosse só uma vez, queria andar de vagonete com os operários."
translations.my: "တစ်ခါလောက်ပဲဖြစ်ဖြစ် အလုပ်သမားတွေနဲ့အတူ ထော်လီ စီးကြည့်ချင်လိုက်တာ။"
translations.th: "แค่ครั้งเดียวก็ยังดี อยากนั่งรถลากกับพวกคนงานจัง"
translations.si: "අඩුම තරමින් එක පාරක් හරි, කම්කරුවෝ එක්ක ට්‍රොලියේ නැගලා බලන්න ආසයි."

grammarNote.my: せめて = အနည်းဆုံး။
grammarNote.th: せめて = อย่างน้อย

sentences.ja: ある夕方のことでした。
sentences.romaji: Aru yuugata no koto deshita.

translations.vi: Chuyện xảy ra vào một buổi chiều.
translations.en: It happened one evening.
translations.zh-Hans: 那是一个傍晚的事。
translations.zh-Hant: 那是一個傍晚的事。
translations.ko: 어느 저녁때의 일이었습니다.
translations.tl: Nangyari ito isang hapon.
translations.ne: एक साँझको कुरा थियो।
translations.id: Itu terjadi pada suatu sore.
translations.pt: Foi numa tarde.
translations.my: ညနေခင်းတစ်ခုမှာ ဖြစ်ခဲ့တာပါ။
translations.th: เป็นเรื่องในเย็นวันหนึ่ง
translations.si: ඒ, එක්තරා සැන්දෑවක සිදු වූ දෙයකි.

grammarNote.my: ある〜 = တစ်ခုသော ~။
grammarNote.th: ある〜 = ~ หนึ่ง

sentences.ja: 良平は、二つ下の弟と、弟と同じ年の近所の子どもといっしょに、村はずれへ行きました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, futatsu shita no otouto to, otouto to onaji toshi no kinjo no kodomo to issho ni, murahazure e ikimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei cùng em trai kém hai tuổi và một đứa trẻ hàng xóm bằng tuổi em, ra đầu làng.
translations.en: Ryōhei went to the edge of the village with his brother, two years younger, and a neighbor's child the same age as his brother.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平和小他两岁的弟弟，还有和弟弟同岁的邻居家孩子，一起去了村口。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平和小他兩歲的弟弟，還有和弟弟同歲的鄰居家孩子，一起去了村口。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 두 살 아래 동생, 그리고 동생과 동갑인 이웃 아이와 함께 마을 어귀로 갔습니다.
translations.tl: Pumunta si Ryōhei sa dulo ng nayon kasama ang kapatid niyang dalawang taon na mas bata at isang batang kapitbahay na kasing-edad ng kapatid.
translations.ne: र्योहेई दुई वर्ष कान्छो भाइ र भाइकै उमेरको छिमेकी बच्चासँग गाउँको छेउमा गयो।
translations.id: Ryōhei pergi ke ujung desa bersama adiknya yang dua tahun lebih muda dan anak tetangga yang sebaya adiknya.
translations.pt: Ryōhei foi à saída da vila com o irmão, dois anos mais novo, e uma criança vizinha da idade do irmão.
translations.my: ရျိုဟေးဟာ နှစ်နှစ်ငယ်တဲ့ ညီလေးနဲ့ ညီလေးနဲ့ ရွယ်တူ အိမ်နီးချင်းကလေးနဲ့ ရွာစွန်ကို သွားတယ်။
translations.th: เรียวเฮไปที่ชายหมู่บ้านกับน้องชายที่อายุน้อยกว่าสองปี และเด็กข้างบ้านที่อายุเท่าน้อง
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, අවුරුදු දෙකක් බාල මල්ලී සහ, මල්ලීගේ වයසේම අසල්වැසි ළමයෙකු සමඟ, ගම් මායිමට ගියේය.

grammarNote.tl: 二つ下 = dalawang taong mas bata.
grammarNote.id: 二つ下 = dua tahun lebih muda.
grammarNote.pt: 二つ下 = dois anos mais novo.
grammarNote.my: 二つ下 = နှစ်နှစ်ငယ်။
grammarNote.th: 二つ下 = อ่อนกว่าสองปี

sentences.ja: トロッコは、どろだらけになったまま、うす明るい中に並んでいました。

furigana.surface: トロッコは、どろだらけになったまま、うす

sentences.romaji: Torokko wa, dorodarake ni natta mama, usu akarui naka ni narandeimashita.

translations.vi: Những chiếc goòng lấm bùn nằm xếp hàng trong ánh chiều nhá nhem.
translations.en: The mud-covered trolleys stood in a row in the dim light.
translations.zh-Hans: 满是泥巴的小矿车，在微亮的暮色中排成一排。
translations.zh-Hant: 滿是泥巴的小礦車，在微亮的暮色中排成一排。
translations.ko: 토롯코는 진흙투성이인 채 어스레한 빛 속에 늘어서 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Nakahanay ang mga trolley na puno ng putik sa malamlam na liwanag.
translations.ne: हिलैहिलो भएका ट्रलीहरू मधुरो उज्यालोमा लाइनमा थिए।
translations.id: Lori-lori berlumpur itu berjajar dalam cahaya remang.
translations.pt: Os vagonetes enlameados estavam enfileirados na penumbra.
translations.my: ရွှံ့ပေနေတဲ့ ထော်လီတွေ မှိန်မှိန်အလင်းထဲမှာ တန်းစီနေကြတယ်။
translations.th: รถลากที่เปื้อนโคลนเรียงกันอยู่ในแสงสลัว
translations.si: ට්‍රොලි, මඩ තැවරුණු ගමන්, අඳුරු එළියේ පෙළට තිබුණි.

grammarNote.my: 〜だらけ = ~ တွေ ပေ။
grammarNote.th: 〜だらけ = เต็มไปด้วย ~

sentences.ja: あたりを見回しても、土工たちの姿はどこにも見えません。
sentences.romaji: Atari o mimawashite mo, dokoutachi no sugata wa doko ni mo miemasen.

translations.vi: Nhìn quanh cũng chẳng thấy bóng dáng người thợ nào.
translations.en: Looking around, there was no sign of the workers anywhere.
translations.zh-Hans: 环顾四周，哪里都看不到土工的身影。
translations.zh-Hant: 環顧四周，哪裡都看不到土工的身影。
translations.ko: 주위를 둘러봐도 인부들의 모습은 어디에도 보이지 않습니다.
translations.tl: Pagtingin sa paligid, walang anino ng mga trabahador kahit saan.
translations.ne: वरपर हेर्दा पनि मजदुरहरू कतै देखिँदैनथे।
translations.id: Dilihat ke sekeliling pun, para buruh tak tampak di mana pun.
translations.pt: Olhando em volta, não havia sinal dos operários.
translations.my: ပတ်ပတ်လည်ကြည့်ပေမဲ့ အလုပ်သမားတွေကို ဘယ်မှာမှ မမြင်ရဘူး။
translations.th: มองไปรอบๆ ก็ไม่เห็นคนงานที่ไหนเลย
translations.si: වටපිට බැලුවත්, කම්කරුවන්ගේ සෙවණැල්ලක්වත් කොතැනකවත් නොපෙනිණි.

meanings.my: ပုံသဏ္ဌာန်

grammarNote.my: 見回す = ပတ်ကြည့်။
grammarNote.th: 見回す = มองไปรอบๆ

sentences.ja: 三人は、こわごわ一番はしのトロッコを押しました。
sentences.romaji: Sannin wa, kowagowa ichiban hashi no torokko o oshimashita.

translations.vi: Ba đứa rón rén đẩy chiếc goòng ở ngoài cùng.
translations.en: The three timidly pushed the trolley at the very end.
translations.zh-Hans: 三个人战战兢兢地推起最边上的那辆小矿车。
translations.zh-Hant: 三個人戰戰兢兢地推起最邊上的那輛小礦車。
translations.ko: 세 아이는 조심조심 맨 끝의 토롯코를 밀었습니다.
translations.tl: Maingat na itinulak ng tatlo ang trolley sa pinakadulo.
translations.ne: तीनै जनाले डराउँदै सबैभन्दा छेउको ट्रली धकेले।
translations.id: Ketiganya dengan takut-takut mendorong lori paling ujung.
translations.pt: Os três, receosos, empurraram o vagonete da ponta.
translations.th: ทั้งสามคนเข็นรถลากคันริมสุดอย่างกล้าๆ กลัวๆ
translations.si: තිදෙනා, බයෙන් බයෙන් කෙළවරේම තිබූ ට්‍රොලිය තල්ලු කළහ.

grammarNote.vi: こわごわ = rụt rè, sợ sệt.
grammarNote.my: こわごわ = ကြောက်ကြောက်နဲ့။
grammarNote.th: こわごわ = กล้าๆ กลัวๆ

sentences.ja: 三人の力がそろうと、トロッコは急にごろりと車輪を回しました。

furigana.surface: がそろうと、トロッコは

sentences.romaji: Sannin no chikara ga sorou to, torokko wa kyuu ni gorori to sharin o mawashimashita.

translations.vi: Khi ba đứa cùng dồn sức, chiếc goòng bỗng lăn bánh lộc cộc.
translations.en: When the three pushed together, the trolley suddenly rolled its wheels with a rumble.
translations.zh-Hans: 三个人一齐用力，小矿车突然咕噜一声转动了车轮。
translations.zh-Hant: 三個人一齊用力，小礦車突然咕嚕一聲轉動了車輪。
translations.ko: 세 아이의 힘이 모이자 토롯코는 갑자기 덜컹 하고 바퀴를 굴렸습니다.
translations.tl: Nang sabay-sabay silang tumulak, biglang umikot ang gulong ng trolley.
translations.ne: तीनै जनाको बल मिल्दा ट्रलीको पाङ्ग्रा अचानक गुडुल्कियो।
translations.id: Saat tenaga ketiganya bersatu, roda lori tiba-tiba berputar.
translations.pt: Quando os três empurraram juntos, as rodas giraram de repente com um ronco.
translations.th: พอทั้งสามออกแรงพร้อมกัน ล้อรถลากก็หมุนครืดขึ้นมาทันที
translations.si: තිදෙනාගේ ශක්තිය එක් වූ විට, ට්‍රොලිය එකවරම ගුඩු ගුඩු ගාමින් රෝද කැරකැවීය.

grammarNote.vi: そろう = đồng đều, khớp nhau.
grammarNote.en: そろう = to be in unison.
grammarNote.my: そろう = ညီ။
grammarNote.th: そろう = พร้อมเพรียง

sentences.ja: 良平は、そのごろごろという音に、少しどきりとしました。

furigana.surface: は、そのごろごろという

sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, sono gorogoro to iu oto ni, sukoshi dokirito shimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei hơi giật thót vì tiếng lộc cộc ấy.
translations.en: The rumbling sound startled Ryōhei a little.
translations.zh-Hans: 那咕噜咕噜的声音，让良平心里一惊。
translations.zh-Hant: 那咕嚕咕嚕的聲音，讓良平心裡一驚。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 그 덜컹덜컹 소리에 조금 가슴이 철렁했습니다.
translations.tl: Medyo nagulat si Ryōhei sa ugong na iyon.
translations.ne: त्यो गुडगुड आवाजले र्योहेई अलि झस्क्यो।
translations.id: Ryōhei sedikit kaget mendengar bunyi gemuruh itu.
translations.pt: O ronco assustou Ryōhei um pouco.
translations.my: အဲဒီ ဂလောက်ဂလောက်အသံကြောင့် ရျိုဟေး နည်းနည်း လန့်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: เสียงครืดคราดนั้นทำให้เรียวเฮใจหายวาบเล็กน้อย
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, ඒ ගුඩු ගුඩු හඬට, මඳක් තිගැස්සුණේය.

grammarNote.vi: どきりとする = giật thót.
grammarNote.en: どきりとする = to be startled.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: どきりとする＝心里一惊。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: どきりとする＝心裡一驚。
grammarNote.my: どきりとする = လန့်။
grammarNote.th: どきりとする = ใจหายวาบ

sentences.ja: やがて線路の坂が急になり、トロッコはもう三人の力では動かなくなりました。

furigana.surface: になり、トロッコはもう

sentences.romaji: Yagate senro no saka ga kyuu ni nari, torokko wa mou sannin no chikara de wa ugokanaku narimashita.

translations.vi: Chẳng mấy chốc dốc đường ray dựng lên, ba đứa không đẩy nổi nữa.
translations.en: Soon the slope grew steep, and the trolley wouldn't move with the strength of the three.
translations.zh-Hans: 不久铁轨的坡变陡了，三个人的力气已经推不动了。
translations.zh-Hant: 不久鐵軌的坡變陡了，三個人的力氣已經推不動了。
translations.ko: 이윽고 선로 비탈이 가팔라져 토롯코는 세 아이의 힘으로는 움직이지 않게 되었습니다.
translations.tl: Maya-maya, tumarik ang dalisdis at hindi na nila maitulak ang trolley.
translations.ne: केहीबेरमा उकालो ठाडो भयो, तीन जनाको बलले ट्रली चल्न छाड्यो।
translations.id: Tak lama kemudian, tanjakan menjadi curam dan lori tak bergerak lagi oleh tenaga mereka.
translations.pt: Logo a subida ficou íngreme, e o vagonete já não se movia com a força dos três.
translations.th: ไม่นานทางลาดก็ชันขึ้น แรงของสามคนเข็นไม่ไหวแล้ว
translations.si: ටික වේලාවකින් රේල් පාරේ බෑවුම තද වූ අතර, ට්‍රොලිය තිදෙනාගේ ශක්තියෙන් තවදුරටත් නොසෙල්වුණි.

meanings.vi: chẳng bao lâu sau, rồi thì
meanings.th: ไม่นานนัก, ในที่สุด

grammarNote.my: 〜なくなる = မ ~ တော့။
grammarNote.th: 〜なくなる = ไม่ ~ อีกแล้ว

sentences.ja: 「さあ、乗ろう。」
sentences.romaji: “Saa, norou.”

translations.vi: “Nào, lên thôi!”
translations.en: "Come on, let's get on!"
translations.zh-Hans: “来，坐上去吧！”
translations.zh-Hant: “來，坐上去吧！”
translations.ko: “자, 타자!”
translations.tl: "Sige, sumakay na tayo!"
translations.id: "Ayo, naik!"
translations.pt: "Vamos, subam!"
translations.th: "เอาละ ขึ้นกันเถอะ"
translations.si: "හරි, නගිමු."

grammarNote.th: 〜よう = ~ กันเถอะ

sentences.ja: 三人がいっしょにとび乗ると、トロッコは線路を下りだしました。
sentences.romaji: Sannin ga issho ni tobi noru to, torokko wa senro o kudaridashimashita.

translations.vi: Ba đứa cùng nhảy lên, chiếc goòng bắt đầu lao xuống theo đường ray.
translations.en: When the three jumped on together, the trolley began to roll down the track.
translations.zh-Hans: 三个人一起跳上去，小矿车就顺着铁轨冲了下去。
translations.zh-Hant: 三個人一起跳上去，小礦車就順著鐵軌衝了下去。
translations.ko: 세 아이가 함께 뛰어오르자 토롯코는 선로를 내려가기 시작했습니다.
translations.tl: Nang sabay silang tumalon pasakay, nagsimulang bumaba ang trolley sa riles.
translations.ne: तीनै जना उफ्रेर चढ्दा ट्रली लिकमा तल झर्न थाल्यो।
translations.id: Saat ketiganya melompat naik, lori mulai meluncur turun di rel.
translations.pt: Quando os três saltaram para dentro, o vagonete começou a descer os trilhos.
translations.my: သုံးယောက် ခုန်တက်လိုက်တော့ ထော်လီက သံလမ်းအတိုင်း လျှောဆင်းလာတယ်။
translations.th: พอทั้งสามกระโดดขึ้นพร้อมกัน รถลากก็เริ่มไหลลงไปตามราง
translations.si: තිදෙනා එකවර පැනලා නැග්ග විට, ට්‍රොලිය රේල් පාර දිගේ පහළට ඇදෙන්නට විය.

grammarNote.en: とび乗る = to jump on.
grammarNote.pt: とび乗る = saltar para dentro.
grammarNote.my: とび乗る = ခုန်တက်။
grammarNote.th: とび乗る = กระโดดขึ้น

sentences.ja: 両側の景色がどんどん後ろへ流れ、良平は顔に夕方の風を受けました。
sentences.romaji: Ryougawa no keshiki ga dondon ushiro e nagare, Ryouhei wa kao ni yuugata no kaze o ukemashita.

translations.vi: Cảnh vật hai bên vùn vụt lùi lại, gió chiều phả vào mặt Ryōhei.
translations.en: The scenery on both sides streamed backward, and Ryōhei felt the evening wind on his face.
translations.zh-Hans: 两旁的景色飞快地向后流去，良平脸上迎着傍晚的风。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩旁的景色飛快地向後流去，良平臉上迎著傍晚的風。
translations.ko: 양쪽 경치가 쑥쑥 뒤로 흘러가고, 료헤이는 얼굴에 저녁 바람을 맞았습니다.
translations.tl: Mabilis na umatras ang tanawin sa magkabilang gilid, at dumampi ang hangin ng hapon sa mukha ni Ryōhei.
translations.ne: दुवैतिरका दृश्य छिटो-छिटो पछाडि बग्दै गए, र्योहेईको अनुहारमा साँझको हावा लाग्यो।
translations.id: Pemandangan di kedua sisi melesat ke belakang, dan angin sore menerpa wajah Ryōhei.
translations.pt: A paisagem dos dois lados corria para trás, e Ryōhei sentiu o vento da tarde no rosto.
translations.my: နှစ်ဖက်က ရှုခင်းတွေ နောက်ကို ဝေ့ခနဲ စီးသွားပြီး ရျိုဟေးမျက်နှာကို ညနေလေ တိုက်တယ်။
translations.th: ทิวทัศน์สองข้างทางไหลไปข้างหลังอย่างรวดเร็ว ลมยามเย็นปะทะหน้าเรียวเฮ
translations.si: දෙපස දර්ශන වේගයෙන් පිටුපසට ගලා ගිය අතර, රියෝහෙයිගේ මුහුණට සැන්දෑ සුළඟ වැදුණි.

grammarNote.vi: どんどん = vùn vụt, liên tục.
grammarNote.en: どんどん = rapidly, one after another.
grammarNote.my: どんどん = ဆက်တိုက်။
grammarNote.th: どんどん = เรื่อยๆ
grammarNote.si: どんどん = වේගයෙන්, එකින් එක.

sentences.ja: 良平は、うれしくて、たまりませんでした。

furigana.surface: は、うれしくて、たまりませんでした。

sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, ureshikute, tamarimasendeshita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei sung sướng không sao tả xiết.
translations.en: Ryōhei was beside himself with joy.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平高兴得不得了。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平高興得不得了。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 너무나 기뻐서 견딜 수가 없었습니다.
translations.tl: Hindi mapigilan ni Ryōhei ang tuwa.
translations.ne: र्योहेई खुसीले फुरुङ्ग भयो।
translations.id: Ryōhei senang bukan main.
translations.pt: Ryōhei não cabia em si de alegria.
translations.th: เรียวเฮดีใจจนแทบทนไม่ไหว
translations.si: රියෝහෙයිට, ඉවසගත නොහැකි තරම් සතුටක් දැනුණි.

grammarNote.vi: 〜てたまらない = ~ không chịu nổi.
grammarNote.ko: 〜てたまらない = ~해서 견딜 수 없다.
grammarNote.my: 〜てたまらない = ~ လွန်းလို့ မနေနိုင်။
grammarNote.th: 〜てたまらない = ~ จนทนไม่ไหว
grammarNote.si: 〜てたまらない = ඉවසගත නොහැකි තරම් ~.

sentences.ja: ところが、トロッコが止まって、もう一度押し上げようとした時です。
sentences.romaji: Tokoroga, torokko ga tomatte, mou ichido oshiageyou to shita toki desu.

translations.vi: Thế nhưng, đúng lúc goòng dừng lại và chúng định đẩy lên lần nữa.
translations.en: But just as the trolley stopped and they tried to push it up again—
translations.zh-Hans: 然而，就在小矿车停下，他们想再推上去的时候。
translations.zh-Hant: 然而，就在小礦車停下，他們想再推上去的時候。
translations.ko: 그런데 토롯코가 멈추고 다시 한 번 밀어 올리려고 할 때였습니다.
translations.tl: Ngunit nang huminto ang trolley at susubukan nilang itulak muli—
translations.ne: तर ट्रली रोकियो र फेरि माथि धकेल्न खोज्दा—
translations.id: Namun, saat lori berhenti dan mereka hendak mendorongnya naik lagi—
translations.pt: Mas, quando o vagonete parou e eles tentaram empurrá-lo de novo—
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ ထော်လီရပ်သွားပြီး နောက်တစ်ခါ တွန်းတင်မယ်လုပ်တုန်း—
translations.th: แต่ตอนที่รถลากหยุด และพวกเขาจะเข็นขึ้นไปอีกครั้ง—
translations.si: එහෙත්, ට්‍රොලිය නැවතී, නැවත ඉහළට තල්ලු කරන්නට උත්සාහ කළ මොහොතේය.

grammarNote.vi: ところが = thế nhưng (bất ngờ).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ところが＝然而（出乎意料）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ところが＝然而（出乎意料）。
grammarNote.my: ところが = ဒါပေမဲ့။
grammarNote.th: ところが = แต่ทว่า

sentences.ja: 「こら！だれにことわってトロッコにさわった？」

furigana.surface: 「こら！だれにことわってトロッコにさわった？」

sentences.romaji: “Kora! Dare ni kotowatte torokko ni sawatta?”

translations.vi: “Này! Xin phép ai mà dám đụng vào goòng hả?”
translations.en: "Hey! Who said you could touch the trolley?"
translations.zh-Hans: “喂！谁允许你们碰小矿车的？”
translations.zh-Hant: “喂！誰允許你們碰小礦車的？”
translations.ko: “이놈! 누구 허락받고 토롯코에 손댔어?”
translations.tl: "Hoy! Sino ang nagpahintulot sa inyong hawakan ang trolley?"
translations.ne: "ए! कसलाई सोधेर ट्रली छोयौ?"
translations.id: "Hei! Siapa yang mengizinkan kalian menyentuh lori?"
translations.pt: "Ei! Quem deixou vocês mexerem no vagonete?"
translations.th: "เฮ้ย! ใครอนุญาตให้แตะรถลาก"
translations.si: "ඕයි! කාගෙන් අහලද ට්‍රොලියට අත තිබ්බේ?"

grammarNote.vi: ことわる = xin phép (ở đây).
grammarNote.en: ことわる = to ask permission (here).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ことわる＝打招呼、征得同意。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ことわる＝打招呼、徵得同意。
grammarNote.my: ことわる = ခွင့်တောင်း။
grammarNote.th: ことわる = ขออนุญาต

sentences.ja: 古いしるし半てんを着た、背の高い土工が立っていました。
sentences.romaji: Furui shirushibanten o kita, se no takai dokou ga tatteimashita.

translations.vi: Một người thợ cao lớn mặc chiếc áo khoác cũ có in hiệu đang đứng đó.
translations.en: A tall worker in an old work coat stood there.
translations.zh-Hans: 一个穿着旧号衣的高个子土工站在那里。
translations.zh-Hant: 一個穿著舊號衣的高個子土工站在那裡。
translations.ko: 낡은 작업복 덧옷을 입은 키 큰 인부가 서 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Nakatayo roon ang isang matangkad na trabahador na nakasuot ng lumang dyaket pantrabaho.
translations.ne: पुरानो कामको कोट लगाएको अग्लो मजदुर उभिएको थियो।
translations.id: Seorang buruh jangkung berbaju kerja tua berdiri di sana.
translations.pt: Um operário alto, com um velho casaco de trabalho, estava ali.
translations.my: အလုပ်ဝတ်စုံဟောင်း ဝတ်ထားတဲ့ အရပ်ရှည်ရှည် အလုပ်သမားတစ်ယောက် ရပ်နေတယ်။
translations.th: คนงานตัวสูงสวมเสื้อคลุมทำงานเก่ายืนอยู่
translations.si: පරණ සලකුණු සහිත වැඩ කබායක් ඇඳි, උස කම්කරුවෙක් සිටගෙන සිටියේය.

grammarNote.vi: しるし半てん = áo khoác thợ có in hiệu.
grammarNote.en: しるし半てん = workman's coat with an emblem.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: しるし半てん＝印有字号的短外衣。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: しるし半てん＝印有字號的短外衣。
grammarNote.ko: しるし半てん = 상호를 새긴 작업용 덧옷.
grammarNote.tl: しるし半てん = dyaket pantrabaho.
grammarNote.ne: しるし半てん = चिह्न भएको कामको कोट।
grammarNote.id: しるし半てん = mantel kerja berlogo.
grammarNote.pt: しるし半てん = casaco com emblema.
grammarNote.my: しるし半てん = တံဆိပ်ပါ အလုပ်ဝတ်။
grammarNote.th: しるし半てん = เสื้อคลุมพิมพ์ตรา
grammarNote.si: しるし半てん = සලකුණක් සහිත කම්කරු කබාය.

sentences.ja: 良平たちは、あわてて、一目散ににげだしました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouheitachi wa, awatete, ichimokusan ni nigedashimashita.

translations.vi: Bọn Ryōhei cuống cuồng, ba chân bốn cẳng bỏ chạy.
translations.en: Ryōhei and the others panicked and ran away as fast as they could.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平他们慌了，一溜烟地逃走了。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平他們慌了，一溜煙地逃走了。
translations.ko: 료헤이 일행은 허둥지둥 쏜살같이 도망쳤습니다.
translations.tl: Nataranta sina Ryōhei at kumaripas ng takbo.
translations.ne: र्योहेईहरू आत्तिएर कुलेलम ठोके।
translations.id: Ryōhei dan kawan-kawan panik dan lari tunggang-langgang.
translations.pt: Ryōhei e os outros, em pânico, fugiram a toda velocidade.
translations.th: เรียวเฮกับเพื่อนตกใจรีบวิ่งหนีสุดชีวิต
translations.si: රියෝහෙයිලා, කලබලයෙන්, හිස් ලූ ලූ අත දුවන්නට විය.

grammarNote.vi: 一目散に = chạy một mạch.
grammarNote.en: 一目散に = at full speed.
grammarNote.pt: 一目散に = a toda velocidade.
grammarNote.my: 一目散に = ခြေကုန်သုတ်။
grammarNote.th: 一目散に = สุดชีวิต
grammarNote.si: 一目散に = හිස් ලූ ලූ අත, මුළු වේගයෙන්.

sentences.ja: それから十日ほどたって、良平はまた一人で工事場に立っていました。
sentences.romaji: Sorekara tooka hodo tatte, Ryouhei wa mata hitori de koujiba ni tatteimashita.

translations.vi: Chừng mười ngày sau, Ryōhei lại đứng một mình ở công trường.
translations.en: About ten days later, Ryōhei was again standing alone at the work site.
translations.zh-Hans: 大约十天以后，良平又一个人站在了工地上。
translations.zh-Hant: 大約十天以後，良平又一個人站在了工地上。
translations.ko: 그로부터 열흘쯤 지나 료헤이는 다시 혼자 공사장에 서 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Mga sampung araw ang lumipas, muling nakatayong mag-isa si Ryōhei sa lugar ng gawain.
translations.ne: करिब दस दिनपछि र्योहेई फेरि एक्लै निर्माणस्थलमा उभिएको थियो।
translations.id: Sekitar sepuluh hari kemudian, Ryōhei kembali berdiri sendirian di lokasi proyek.
translations.pt: Uns dez dias depois, Ryōhei estava de novo sozinho no canteiro de obras.
translations.my: ဆယ်ရက်လောက်ကြာတော့ ရျိုဟေး ဆောက်လုပ်ရေးနေရာမှာ တစ်ယောက်တည်း ပြန်ရပ်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ราวสิบวันต่อมา เรียวเฮก็มายืนคนเดียวที่ไซต์งานอีก
translations.si: ඉන් දින දහයක් පමණ ගත වූ පසු, රියෝහෙයි නැවතත් තනිවම වැඩබිමේ සිටගෙන සිටියේය.

grammarNote.th: 〜ほど = ราว ~

sentences.ja: 今度は、材木を積んだトロッコを、二人の若い男が押していました。
sentences.romaji: Kondo wa, zaimoku o tsunda torokko o, futari no wakai otoko ga oshiteimashita.

translations.vi: Lần này, hai thanh niên đang đẩy một chiếc goòng chở gỗ.
translations.en: This time, two young men were pushing a trolley loaded with timber.
translations.zh-Hans: 这次，两个年轻人正推着装木材的小矿车。
translations.zh-Hant: 這次，兩個年輕人正推著裝木材的小礦車。
translations.ko: 이번에는 목재를 실은 토롯코를 젊은 남자 두 명이 밀고 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Ngayon, dalawang binata ang nagtutulak ng trolley na may kargang tabla.
translations.ne: यसपटक काठ लादेको ट्रली दुई युवकले धकेलिरहेका थिए।
translations.id: Kali ini, dua pemuda sedang mendorong lori bermuatan kayu.
translations.pt: Desta vez, dois rapazes empurravam um vagonete carregado de madeira.
translations.my: ဒီတစ်ခါ သစ်တင်ထားတဲ့ ထော်လီကို လူငယ်နှစ်ယောက် တွန်းနေတယ်။
translations.th: คราวนี้ ชายหนุ่มสองคนกำลังเข็นรถลากที่บรรทุกไม้
translations.si: මෙවර, දැව පටවා ඇති ට්‍රොලියක්, තරුණයන් දෙදෙනෙක් තල්ලු කරමින් සිටියහ.

grammarNote.my: 材木 = သစ်။
grammarNote.th: 材木 = ไม้แปรรูป

sentences.ja: その二人は、どこか親しみやすそうな顔をしていました。
sentences.romaji: Sono futari wa, doko ka shitashimiyasusou na kao o shiteimashita.

translations.vi: Hai người ấy có gương mặt trông dễ gần.
translations.en: The two had faces that looked somehow friendly.
translations.zh-Hans: 那两个人看上去有点和蔼可亲。
translations.zh-Hant: 那兩個人看上去有點和藹可親。
translations.ko: 그 두 사람은 어딘가 친근해 보이는 얼굴이었습니다.
translations.tl: Mukhang palakaibigan ang dalawa.
translations.ne: ती दुई जना कतै मिलनसार देखिन्थे।
translations.id: Keduanya berwajah agak ramah.
translations.pt: Os dois tinham um ar simpático.
translations.my: အဲဒီနှစ်ယောက်က ရင်းနှီးလွယ်ပုံ မျက်နှာမျိုး ရှိတယ်။
translations.th: ทั้งสองคนมีหน้าตาดูเป็นมิตร
translations.si: ඒ දෙදෙනාට, කොහේදෝ මිත්‍රශීලී පෙනුමක් ඇති මුහුණු තිබුණි.

grammarNote.vi: 〜やすそう = trông có vẻ dễ ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜やすそう = ~ ရလွယ်ပုံ။
grammarNote.th: 〜やすそう = ดูเหมือน ~ ง่าย

sentences.ja: 「おじさん、押してやろうか。」
sentences.romaji: “Ojisan, oshiteyarou ka.”

translations.vi: “Chú ơi, cháu đẩy giúp nhé?”
translations.en: "Mister, shall I help you push?"
translations.zh-Hans: “叔叔，我帮你推吧？”
translations.zh-Hant: “叔叔，我幫你推吧？”
translations.ko: “아저씨, 밀어 드릴까요?”
translations.tl: "Manong, tutulungan ko kayong magtulak?"
translations.ne: "काका, म धकेलिदिऊँ?"
translations.id: "Paman, mau saya bantu dorong?"
translations.pt: "Moço, quer que eu ajude a empurrar?"
translations.th: "น้า ให้ช่วยเข็นไหม"
translations.si: "මාමේ, තල්ලු කරලා දෙන්නද?"

grammarNote.vi: 〜てやろうか = để cháu ~ giúp nhé (trẻ con nói).
grammarNote.en: 〜てやろうか = shall I ~ for you.
grammarNote.tl: 〜てやろうか = gusto mo bang ~ ko.
grammarNote.my: 〜てやろうか = ~ ပေးရမလား။
grammarNote.th: 〜てやろうか = ให้ ~ ไหม

sentences.ja: 「おお、押してくよう。」
sentences.romaji: “Oo, oshite kuyou.”

translations.vi: “Ồ, đẩy đi nào.”
translations.en: "Oh, go ahead and push."
translations.zh-Hans: “哦，推吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “哦，推吧。”
translations.ko: “오, 밀어 다오.”
translations.tl: "O, sige, itulak mo."
translations.ne: "ओहो, धकेल न।"
translations.id: "Oh, dorong saja."
translations.pt: "Ah, empurra aí."
translations.th: "เออ เข็นเลย"
translations.si: "ඕ, තල්ලු කරපන්."

grammarNote.vi: 押してくよう = giọng địa phương: đẩy đi.
grammarNote.en: 押してくよう = dialect: go on, push.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 押してくよう＝方言：推吧。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 押してくよう＝方言：推吧。
grammarNote.ko: 押してくよう = 사투리: 밀어 다오.
grammarNote.tl: 押してくよう = diyalekto: itulak mo.
grammarNote.ne: 押してくよう = स्थानीय बोली: धकेल।
grammarNote.id: 押してくよう = dialek: dorong.
grammarNote.pt: 押してくよう = dialeto: empurra.
grammarNote.my: 押してくよう = ဒေသစကား: တွန်း။
grammarNote.th: 押してくよう = ภาษาถิ่น: เข็นเลย
grammarNote.si: 押してくよう = උපභාෂාව: හරි, තල්ලු කරපන්.

sentences.ja: 良平は二人の間に入り、力いっぱいトロッコを押し始めました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa futari no aida ni hairi, chikaraippai torokko o oshihajimemashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei chen vào giữa hai người, dốc hết sức đẩy goòng.
translations.en: Ryōhei squeezed between the two and began pushing with all his might.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平挤到两人中间，使出全身力气推起小矿车。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平擠到兩人中間，使出全身力氣推起小礦車。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 두 사람 사이에 끼어 힘껏 토롯코를 밀기 시작했습니다.
translations.tl: Sumingit si Ryōhei sa gitna ng dalawa at buong lakas na nagtulak.
translations.ne: र्योहेई दुई जनाको बीचमा पसेर सारा बलले ट्रली धकेल्न थाल्यो।
translations.id: Ryōhei menyelip di antara keduanya dan mulai mendorong sekuat tenaga.
translations.pt: Ryōhei se meteu entre os dois e começou a empurrar com toda a força.
translations.th: เรียวเฮแทรกเข้าไประหว่างสองคน แล้วเริ่มออกแรงเข็นสุดกำลัง
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි දෙදෙනා අතරට රිංගා, මුළු ශක්තියෙන්ම ට්‍රොලිය තල්ලු කරන්නට පටන් ගත්තේය.

grammarNote.vi: 力いっぱい = dốc hết sức.
grammarNote.en: 力いっぱい = with all one's strength.
grammarNote.pt: 力いっぱい = com toda a força.
grammarNote.my: 力いっぱい = အားကုန်။
grammarNote.th: 力いっぱい = สุดแรง

sentences.ja: 「われはなかなか力があるな。」
sentences.romaji: “Ware wa nakanaka chikara ga aru na.”

translations.vi: “Mày khỏe gớm nhỉ.”
translations.en: "You're pretty strong, aren't you."
translations.zh-Hans: “你小子力气不小嘛。”
translations.zh-Hant: “你小子力氣不小嘛。”
translations.ko: “너 꽤 힘이 세구나.”
translations.tl: "Malakas ka pala, bata."
translations.ne: "तँ त निकै बलियो रहेछस्।"
translations.id: "Kau kuat juga ya."
translations.pt: "Você é bem forte, hein."
translations.th: "เจ้านี่แรงดีนะ"
translations.si: "උඹට හොඳ ශක්තියක් තියෙනවා නේ."

grammarNote.my: われ = မင်း (ဒေသစကား)။
grammarNote.th: われ = เจ้า (ภาษาถิ่น)

sentences.ja: もう一人の男も、横から良平をほめてくれました。
sentences.romaji: Mou hitori no otoko mo, yoko kara Ryouhei o hometekuremashita.

translations.vi: Người kia cũng khen Ryōhei từ bên cạnh.
translations.en: The other man praised Ryōhei too, from the side.
translations.zh-Hans: 另一个男人也从旁边夸奖良平。
translations.zh-Hant: 另一個男人也從旁邊誇獎良平。
translations.ko: 다른 한 남자도 옆에서 료헤이를 칭찬해 주었습니다.
translations.tl: Pinuri rin si Ryōhei ng isa pang lalaki mula sa tabi.
translations.ne: अर्को मान्छेले पनि छेउबाट र्योहेईको प्रशंसा गर्‍यो।
translations.id: Pria satunya juga memuji Ryōhei dari samping.
translations.pt: O outro homem também elogiou Ryōhei de lado.
translations.my: နောက်တစ်ယောက်ကလည်း ဘေးကနေ ရျိုဟေးကို ချီးကျူးတယ်။
translations.th: ชายอีกคนก็ชมเรียวเฮจากข้างๆ
translations.si: අනෙක් මිනිසාත්, පැත්තකින් රියෝහෙයිට ප්‍රශංසා කළේය.

grammarNote.my: 〜てくれる = ~ ပေး။
grammarNote.th: 〜てくれる = ~ ให้

sentences.ja: 「いつまでも押していていい？」
sentences.romaji: “Itsu made mo oshiteiteii?”

translations.vi: “Cháu đẩy mãi được không ạ?”
translations.en: "Can I keep pushing forever?"
translations.zh-Hans: “我可以一直推下去吗？”
translations.zh-Hant: “我可以一直推下去嗎？”
translations.ko: “언제까지나 밀어도 돼요?”
translations.tl: "Puwede ko bang itulak hanggang gusto ko?"
translations.ne: "सधैं धकेलिरहन पाउँछु?"
translations.id: "Boleh saya dorong terus?"
translations.pt: "Posso continuar empurrando para sempre?"
translations.th: "เข็นไปตลอดได้ไหม"
translations.si: "හැමදාම තල්ලු කරන්න පුළුවන්ද?"

grammarNote.vi: 〜ていていい？ = cứ ~ mãi được không?
grammarNote.my: 〜ていていい？ = ~ နေလို့ရလား။
grammarNote.th: 〜ていていい？ = ~ ต่อไปได้ไหม
grammarNote.si: 〜ていていい？ = දිගටම ~ කළාට කමක් නැද්ද?

sentences.ja: 「いいとも。」
sentences.romaji: “Ii to mo.”

translations.vi: “Được chứ.”
translations.en: "Sure."
translations.zh-Hans: “当然可以。”
translations.zh-Hant: “當然可以。”
translations.ko: “그럼.”
translations.tl: "Oo naman."
translations.ne: "हुन्छ नि।"
translations.id: "Tentu."
translations.pt: "Claro."
translations.th: "ได้สิ"
translations.si: "පුළුවන් තමයි."

grammarNote.th: 〜とも = แน่นอน ~

sentences.ja: 良平は、この二人はやさしい人たちだと思いました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, kono futari wa yasashii hitotachi da to omoimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei nghĩ hai người này thật tốt bụng.
translations.en: Ryōhei thought these two were kind people.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平觉得这两个人真是好心人。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平覺得這兩個人真是好心人。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 이 두 사람은 친절한 사람들이라고 생각했습니다.
translations.tl: Inisip ni Ryōhei na mababait ang dalawang ito.
translations.ne: र्योहेईले यी दुई दयालु मान्छे हुन् भन्ने सोच्यो।
translations.id: Ryōhei mengira kedua orang ini baik hati.
translations.pt: Ryōhei achou que aqueles dois eram gente boa.
translations.my: ရျိုဟေးက ဒီနှစ်ယောက်ဟာ သဘောကောင်းတဲ့သူတွေလို့ ထင်တယ်။
translations.th: เรียวเฮคิดว่าสองคนนี้เป็นคนใจดี
translations.si: රියෝහෙයිට, මේ දෙදෙනා කාරුණික අය බව සිතුණි.

grammarNote.my: 〜だと思う = ~ လို့ထင်။
grammarNote.th: 〜だと思う = คิดว่า ~

sentences.ja: 線路の坂を上りきると、三人はトロッコにとび乗りました。
sentences.romaji: Senro no saka o nobori kiru to, sannin wa torokko ni tobi norimashita.

translations.vi: Lên hết con dốc, cả ba nhảy lên goòng.
translations.en: After pushing to the top of the slope, the three jumped onto the trolley.
translations.zh-Hans: 爬完铁轨的坡，三个人跳上了小矿车。
translations.zh-Hant: 爬完鐵軌的坡，三個人跳上了小礦車。
translations.ko: 선로 비탈을 다 오르자 세 사람은 토롯코에 뛰어올랐습니다.
translations.tl: Pagdating sa tuktok ng dalisdis, tumalon ang tatlo sa trolley.
translations.ne: उकालो सकिएपछि तीनै जना ट्रलीमा उफ्रेर चढे।
translations.id: Setelah tanjakan habis didaki, ketiganya melompat ke lori.
translations.pt: Ao chegar ao topo da subida, os três saltaram no vagonete.
translations.th: พอขึ้นทางลาดจนสุด ทั้งสามก็กระโดดขึ้นรถลาก
translations.si: රේල් පාරේ බෑවුම මුදුනටම තල්ලු කළ පසු, තිදෙනා ට්‍රොලියට පැන නැග්ගහ.

grammarNote.th: 〜きる = ~ จนสุด

sentences.ja: みかん畑の間を、トロッコは風のように走り下りていきます。
sentences.romaji: Mikanbatake no aida o, torokko wa kaze no you ni hashiri oriteikimasu.

translations.vi: Goòng lao xuống như gió giữa những vườn quýt.
translations.en: The trolley raced down like the wind between the tangerine orchards.
translations.zh-Hans: 小矿车像风一样从橘子园中间冲下去。
translations.zh-Hant: 小礦車像風一樣從橘子園中間衝下去。
translations.ko: 토롯코는 귤밭 사이를 바람처럼 달려 내려갑니다.
translations.tl: Bumulusok ang trolley na parang hangin sa pagitan ng mga taniman ng dalandan.
translations.ne: ट्रली सुन्तला बगैंचाबीच हावाझैं दौडेर झर्‍यो।
translations.id: Lori meluncur seperti angin di antara kebun jeruk.
translations.pt: O vagonete desceu como o vento entre os pomares de tangerina.
translations.th: รถลากพุ่งลงไปเหมือนลมผ่านระหว่างสวนส้ม
translations.si: නාරං වතු අතරින්, ට්‍රොලිය සුළඟ මෙන් පහළට දිව යයි.

grammarNote.my: 〜のように = ~ လို။
grammarNote.th: 〜のように = เหมือน ~

sentences.ja: あたたかいみかんの香りが、良平の顔にふきつけてきました。

furigana.surface: にふきつけてきました。

sentences.romaji: Atatakai mikan no kaori ga, Ryouhei no kao ni fukitsuketekimashita.

translations.vi: Hương quýt ấm áp phả vào mặt Ryōhei.
translations.en: The warm scent of tangerines blew against Ryōhei's face.
translations.zh-Hans: 温暖的橘子香气扑面而来。
translations.zh-Hant: 溫暖的橘子香氣撲面而來。
translations.ko: 따뜻한 귤 향기가 료헤이의 얼굴에 불어왔습니다.
translations.tl: Dumampi sa mukha ni Ryōhei ang mainit na bango ng dalandan.
translations.ne: सुन्तलाको न्यानो बास्ना र्योहेईको अनुहारमा ठोक्कियो।
translations.id: Aroma jeruk yang hangat menerpa wajah Ryōhei.
translations.pt: O aroma morno das tangerinas soprava no rosto de Ryōhei.
translations.my: နွေးထွေးတဲ့ လိမ္မော်ရနံ့က ရျိုဟေးမျက်နှာကို တိုက်ခတ်လာတယ်။
translations.th: กลิ่นหอมอบอุ่นของส้มโชยมาปะทะหน้าเรียวเฮ
translations.si: උණුසුම් නාරං සුවඳ, රියෝහෙයිගේ මුහුණට හමා ආවේය.

grammarNote.vi: ふきつける = thổi phả vào.
grammarNote.en: ふきつける = to blow against.
grammarNote.my: ふきつける = တိုက်ခတ်။
grammarNote.th: ふきつける = พัดปะทะ

sentences.ja: やがて、竹やぶの向こうに、広々とした海が見えてきました。
sentences.romaji: Yagate, takeyabu no mukou ni, hirobiro to shita umi ga mietekimashita.

translations.vi: Rồi bên kia bụi tre, biển cả mênh mông hiện ra.
translations.en: Soon, beyond the bamboo grove, the vast sea came into view.
translations.zh-Hans: 不久，竹林那边出现了辽阔的大海。
translations.zh-Hant: 不久，竹林那邊出現了遼闊的大海。
translations.ko: 이윽고 대숲 너머로 드넓은 바다가 보였습니다.
translations.tl: Maya-maya, sa kabila ng kawayanan, natanaw ang malawak na dagat.
translations.ne: केहीबेरमा बाँसघारीपारि फराकिलो समुद्र देखियो।
translations.id: Tak lama, di balik rumpun bambu, tampak laut yang luas.
translations.pt: Logo, além do bambuzal, surgiu o mar imenso.
translations.my: မကြာခင် ဝါးရုံရဲ့ဟိုဘက်မှာ ကျယ်ပြန့်တဲ့ပင်လယ်ကို မြင်လာရတယ်။
translations.th: ไม่นาน ทะเลกว้างใหญ่ก็ปรากฏให้เห็นอยู่หลังกอไผ่
translations.si: ටික වේලාවකින්, උණ පඳුරට එපිටින්, විශාල මුහුද පෙනෙන්නට විය.

grammarNote.vi: 広々とした = rộng mênh mông.
grammarNote.my: 広々とした = ကျယ်ပြန့်။
grammarNote.th: 広々とした = กว้างใหญ่

sentences.ja: その時、良平は、ずいぶん遠くまで来てしまったことに気がつきました。
sentences.romaji: Sono toki, Ryouhei wa, zuibun tooku made kiteshimatta koto ni kigatsukimashita.

translations.vi: Lúc ấy, Ryōhei mới nhận ra mình đã đi quá xa.
translations.en: At that moment, Ryōhei realized he had come very far.
translations.zh-Hans: 那时，良平才发觉自己已经走得很远了。
translations.zh-Hant: 那時，良平才發覺自己已經走得很遠了。
translations.ko: 그때 료헤이는 아주 멀리까지 와 버렸다는 것을 깨달았습니다.
translations.tl: Noon napagtanto ni Ryōhei na napakalayo na niya.
translations.ne: त्यतिबेला र्योहेईलाई निकै टाढा आइपुगेको थाहा भयो।
translations.id: Saat itu Ryōhei sadar ia sudah datang terlalu jauh.
translations.pt: Nesse momento, Ryōhei percebeu que tinha ido longe demais.
translations.my: အဲဒီအချိန်မှာ ရျိုဟေး အတော်ဝေးဝေး ရောက်လာပြီဆိုတာ သတိထားမိတယ်။
translations.th: ตอนนั้นเองเรียวเฮรู้ตัวว่ามาไกลมากแล้ว
translations.si: ඒ මොහොතේ, රියෝහෙයිට, තමා ඉතා ඈතකට පැමිණ ඇති බව වැටහුණි.

grammarNote.vi: 〜ことに気がつく = nhận ra rằng ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜ことに気がつく = to realize that ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜ことに気がつく = ~ တာ သတိထားမိ။
grammarNote.th: 〜ことに気がつく = รู้ตัวว่า ~

sentences.ja: トロッコは、それからも何度も上っては下り、下っては上りました。

furigana.surface: トロッコは、それからも

sentences.romaji: Torokko wa, sore kara mo nandomo nobotte wa kudari, kudatte wa noborimashita.

translations.vi: Sau đó goòng còn lên dốc rồi xuống dốc, xuống rồi lại lên, không biết bao nhiêu lần.
translations.en: After that, the trolley went up and down, down and up, many more times.
translations.zh-Hans: 此后，小矿车又上了下、下了上，好多次。
translations.zh-Hant: 此後，小礦車又上了下、下了上，好多次。
translations.ko: 토롯코는 그 뒤로도 몇 번이나 오르고는 내리고, 내리고는 올랐습니다.
translations.tl: Pagkatapos, ilang ulit pang umakyat at bumaba, bumaba at umakyat ang trolley.
translations.ne: त्यसपछि पनि ट्रली पटक-पटक उकालो-ओरालो गर्‍यो।
translations.id: Setelah itu, lori berkali-kali naik lalu turun, turun lalu naik.
translations.pt: Depois, o vagonete subiu e desceu, desceu e subiu, muitas vezes.
translations.my: အဲဒီနောက်လည်း ထော်လီဟာ အကြိမ်ကြိမ် တက်လိုက်ဆင်းလိုက် ဖြစ်တယ်။
translations.th: หลังจากนั้น รถลากก็ขึ้นๆ ลงๆ อีกหลายครั้ง
translations.si: ට්‍රොලිය, ඉන් පසුවත් කිහිප වරක්ම නැග නැග බැස්සේය, බැස බැස නැග්ගේය.

grammarNote.th: 〜ては〜 = ~ แล้วก็ ~ ซ้ำๆ

sentences.ja: とちゅうの茶店で、二人の男はゆっくりお茶を飲み始めました。
sentences.romaji: Tochuu no chamise de, futari no otoko wa yukkuri ocha o nomihajimemashita.

translations.vi: Ở một quán trà dọc đường, hai người đàn ông thong thả ngồi uống trà.
translations.en: At a teahouse along the way, the two men leisurely began drinking tea.
translations.zh-Hans: 在半路的茶馆里，两个男人慢悠悠地喝起茶来。
translations.zh-Hant: 在半路的茶館裡，兩個男人慢悠悠地喝起茶來。
translations.ko: 도중의 찻집에서 두 남자는 느긋하게 차를 마시기 시작했습니다.
translations.tl: Sa isang tindahan ng tsaa sa daan, nagsimulang uminom ng tsaa nang dahan-dahan ang dalawa.
translations.ne: बाटोको चिया पसलमा दुई जना आरामसँग चिया पिउन थाले।
translations.id: Di sebuah kedai teh di tengah jalan, kedua pria itu mulai minum teh dengan santai.
translations.pt: Numa casa de chá no caminho, os dois homens começaram a beber chá sem pressa.
translations.my: လမ်းခုလတ်က လက်ဖက်ရည်ဆိုင်မှာ လူနှစ်ယောက်က အေးအေးဆေးဆေး လက်ဖက်ရည် စသောက်ကြတယ်။
translations.th: ที่ร้านน้ำชาระหว่างทาง ชายทั้งสองเริ่มดื่มชาอย่างสบายๆ
translations.si: අතරමඟ තේ කඩයකදී, මිනිසුන් දෙදෙනා නිදහසේ තේ බොන්නට පටන් ගත්හ.

grammarNote.en: とちゅう = on the way.
grammarNote.id: とちゅう = di tengah jalan.
grammarNote.my: とちゅう = လမ်းခုလတ်။
grammarNote.th: とちゅう = ระหว่างทาง

sentences.ja: 良平は一人で、いらいらしながらトロッコのまわりを回っていました。

furigana.surface: で、いらいらしながらトロッコのまわりを

sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa hitori de, irairashinagara torokko no mawari o mawatteimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei một mình sốt ruột đi vòng quanh chiếc goòng.
translations.en: Ryōhei, alone and impatient, walked around and around the trolley.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平一个人焦躁地绕着小矿车转来转去。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平一個人焦躁地繞著小礦車轉來轉去。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 혼자 안절부절못하며 토롯코 주위를 돌고 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Mag-isang paikot-ikot si Ryōhei sa trolley, naiinip.
translations.ne: र्योहेई एक्लै छटपटाउँदै ट्रली वरिपरि घुमिरह्यो।
translations.id: Ryōhei sendirian berputar-putar di sekitar lori dengan gelisah.
translations.pt: Ryōhei, sozinho e impaciente, rodeava o vagonete.
translations.my: ရျိုဟေး တစ်ယောက်တည်း စိတ်မရှည်ဘဲ ထော်လီပတ်ပတ်လည် လှည့်လည်နေတယ်။
translations.th: เรียวเฮเดินวนรอบรถลากคนเดียวอย่างกระวนกระวาย
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි තනිවම, නොඉවසිලිමත්ව ට්‍රොලිය වටේ ඇවිදිමින් සිටියේය.

meanings.my: စိတ်တိုခြင်း

grammarNote.vi: いらいら = sốt ruột, bực bội.
grammarNote.my: いらいら = စိတ်မရှည်။
grammarNote.th: いらいら = หงุดหงิด

sentences.ja: 男の一人が、新聞紙に包んだおかしを、良平にくれました。
sentences.romaji: Otoko no hitori ga, shinbunshi ni tsutsunda okashi o, Ryouhei ni kuremashita.

translations.vi: Một người đưa cho Ryōhei mấy chiếc bánh kẹo gói trong giấy báo.
translations.en: One of the men gave Ryōhei some sweets wrapped in newspaper.
translations.zh-Hans: 其中一个男人给了良平一些用报纸包着的点心。
translations.zh-Hant: 其中一個男人給了良平一些用報紙包著的點心。
translations.ko: 남자 한 명이 신문지에 싼 과자를 료헤이에게 주었습니다.
translations.tl: Binigyan ng isa sa mga lalaki si Ryōhei ng matamis na nakabalot sa diyaryo.
translations.ne: एक जनाले अखबारमा बेरेको मिठाई र्योहेईलाई दियो।
translations.id: Salah satu pria memberi Ryōhei kue yang dibungkus koran.
translations.pt: Um dos homens deu a Ryōhei uns doces embrulhados em jornal.
translations.my: လူတစ်ယောက်က သတင်းစာနဲ့ထုပ်ထားတဲ့ မုန့်ကို ရျိုဟေးကို ပေးတယ်။
translations.th: ชายคนหนึ่งให้ขนมที่ห่อด้วยหนังสือพิมพ์แก่เรียวเฮ
translations.si: මිනිසුන්ගෙන් එක් අයෙක්, පුවත්පතක ඔතපු රසකැවිලි කීපයක්, රියෝහෙයිට දුන්නේය.

grammarNote.my: 包む = ထုပ်။
grammarNote.th: 包む = ห่อ

sentences.ja: おかしには、新聞紙のせいか、石油のにおいがしみついていました。

furigana.surface: のにおいがしみついていました。

sentences.romaji: Okashi ni wa, shinbunshi no sei ka, sekiyu no nioi ga shimitsuiteimashita.

translations.vi: Có lẽ vì giấy báo mà bánh ngấm mùi dầu hỏa.
translations.en: Perhaps because of the newspaper, the sweets reeked of kerosene.
translations.zh-Hans: 也许是因为报纸，点心上沾满了煤油味。
translations.zh-Hant: 也許是因為報紙，點心上沾滿了煤油味。
translations.ko: 신문지 탓인지 과자에는 석유 냄새가 배어 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Marahil dahil sa diyaryo, amoy-gaas ang matamis.
translations.ne: सायद अखबारले गर्दा मिठाईमा मट्टितेलको गन्ध बसेको थियो।
translations.id: Mungkin karena koran, kue itu berbau minyak tanah.
translations.pt: Talvez por causa do jornal, os doces cheiravam a querosene.
translations.my: သတင်းစာကြောင့်လားမသိ မုန့်မှာ ရေနံဆီနံ့ စွဲနေတယ်။
translations.th: อาจเพราะหนังสือพิมพ์ ขนมจึงมีกลิ่นน้ำมันก๊าดติดอยู่
translations.si: රසකැවිලිවල, පුවත්පත නිසාදෝ, භූමිතෙල් ගඳක් කාවැදී තිබුණි.

grammarNote.pt: 〜のせいか = talvez por causa de ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜のせいか = ~ ကြောင့်လားမသိ။
grammarNote.th: 〜のせいか = อาจเพราะ ~

sentences.ja: 良平は、冷たく「ありがとう」と言いましたが、すぐに悪いと思いなおしました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, tsumetaku “Arigatou” to iimashita ga, sugu ni warui to omoinaoshimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei nói “cảm ơn” một cách lạnh nhạt, nhưng ngay sau đó thấy mình có lỗi.
translations.en: Ryōhei said "thank you" coldly, but soon felt he'd been rude.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平冷淡地说了声“谢谢”，但马上又觉得不好意思。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平冷淡地說了聲“謝謝”，但馬上又覺得不好意思。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 차갑게 “고마워요”라고 말했지만 곧 미안하다고 고쳐 생각했습니다.
translations.tl: Malamig na nagsabi si Ryōhei ng "salamat," pero agad niyang naisip na mali iyon.
translations.ne: र्योहेईले चिसो स्वरमा "धन्यवाद" भन्यो, तर तुरुन्तै नराम्रो गरें भन्ने सोच्यो।
translations.id: Ryōhei berkata "terima kasih" dengan dingin, tapi segera merasa tak enak.
translations.pt: Ryōhei disse "obrigado" friamente, mas logo se sentiu mal.
translations.th: เรียวเฮพูดว่า "ขอบคุณ" อย่างเย็นชา แต่ก็รู้สึกผิดขึ้นมาทันที
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, සීතල ලෙස "ස්තූතියි" කිව්වත්, ඉක්මනින්ම එය වැරදි බව නැවත සිතුවේය.

grammarNote.my: 思いなおす = ပြန်တွေး။
grammarNote.th: 思いなおす = คิดใหม่

sentences.ja: 日は、少しずつかたむいていきます。

furigana.surface: しずつかたむいていきます。

sentences.romaji: Hi wa, sukoshi zutsu katamuiteikimasu.

translations.vi: Mặt trời cứ nghiêng dần.
translations.en: The sun was gradually sinking.
translations.zh-Hans: 太阳渐渐西斜了。
translations.zh-Hant: 太陽漸漸西斜了。
translations.ko: 해는 조금씩 기울어 갑니다.
translations.tl: Unti-unting lumulubog ang araw.
translations.ne: घाम बिस्तारै ढल्किँदै थियो।
translations.id: Matahari perlahan condong.
translations.pt: O sol ia se inclinando aos poucos.
translations.my: နေက တဖြည်းဖြည်း စောင်းလာတယ်။
translations.th: ดวงอาทิตย์ค่อยๆ คล้อยต่ำลง
translations.si: ඉර, ටිකෙන් ටික බැස යමින් තිබුණි.

grammarNote.vi: かたむく = nghiêng, xế (mặt trời).
grammarNote.en: かたむく = to sink, tilt.
grammarNote.my: かたむく = စောင်း။
grammarNote.th: かたむく = คล้อย
grammarNote.si: かたむく = (ඉර) බහිනවා, ඇල වෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 良平は、早く帰りたいとばかり思っていました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, hayaku kaeritai to bakari omotteimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei chỉ mong được về nhà thật nhanh.
translations.en: Ryōhei thought of nothing but getting home quickly.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平一心只想快点回家。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平一心只想快點回家。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 빨리 돌아가고 싶다는 생각뿐이었습니다.
translations.tl: Ang tanging nasa isip ni Ryōhei ay makauwi agad.
translations.ne: र्योहेई छिटो घर फर्कने कुरा मात्र सोचिरहेको थियो।
translations.id: Ryōhei hanya ingin cepat pulang.
translations.pt: Ryōhei só pensava em voltar logo para casa.
translations.my: ရျိုဟေး မြန်မြန်ပြန်ချင်တာပဲ တွေးနေတယ်။
translations.th: เรียวเฮคิดแต่ว่าอยากรีบกลับบ้าน
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, ඉක්මනින් ගෙදර යන්නට පමණක් සිතමින් සිටියේය.

grammarNote.vi: 〜とばかり思う = chỉ toàn nghĩ ~.
grammarNote.en: 〜とばかり思う = think only of ~.
grammarNote.tl: 〜とばかり思う = ~ lang ang iniisip.
grammarNote.pt: 〜とばかり思う = só pensar em ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜とばかり思う = ~ ပဲ တွေး။
grammarNote.th: 〜とばかり思う = คิดแต่ ~
grammarNote.si: 〜とばかり思う = ~ ගැන පමණක් සිතනවා.

sentences.ja: 二度目の茶店を出た時、男の一人が、ひょいと良平の方を見ました。
sentences.romaji: Nidome no chamise o deta toki, otoko no hitori ga, hyoito Ryouhei no hou o mimashita.

translations.vi: Khi rời quán trà thứ hai, một người bỗng quay sang nhìn Ryōhei.
translations.en: As they left the second teahouse, one man casually turned to Ryōhei.
translations.zh-Hans: 离开第二家茶馆时，一个男人忽然看向良平。
translations.zh-Hant: 離開第二家茶館時，一個男人忽然看向良平。
translations.ko: 두 번째 찻집을 나왔을 때 남자 한 명이 불쑥 료헤이 쪽을 보았습니다.
translations.tl: Paglabas sa ikalawang tindahan ng tsaa, biglang tumingin ang isang lalaki kay Ryōhei.
translations.ne: दोस्रो चिया पसलबाट निस्कँदा एक जनाले अचानक र्योहेईतिर हेर्‍यो।
translations.id: Saat keluar dari kedai teh kedua, seorang pria tiba-tiba menoleh ke Ryōhei.
translations.pt: Ao saírem da segunda casa de chá, um dos homens olhou de repente para Ryōhei.
translations.my: ဒုတိယ လက်ဖက်ရည်ဆိုင်က ထွက်တော့ လူတစ်ယောက်က ရုတ်တရက် ရျိုဟေးဘက် လှည့်ကြည့်တယ်။
translations.th: ตอนออกจากร้านน้ำชาร้านที่สอง ชายคนหนึ่งหันมามองเรียวเฮทันที
translations.si: දෙවන තේ කඩයෙන් පිටත් වූ විට, මිනිසුන්ගෙන් එක් අයෙක්, හදිසියේම රියෝහෙයි දෙස බැලුවේය.

grammarNote.vi: ひょいと = bất chợt, tỉnh bơ.
grammarNote.my: ひょいと = ရုတ်တရက်။
grammarNote.th: ひょいと = ทันที

sentences.ja: 「われはもう帰んな。おれたちは今日は向こうにとまりだから。」
sentences.romaji: “Ware wa mou kaenna. Oretachi wa kyou wa mukou ni tomarida kara.”

translations.vi: “Mày về đi thôi. Hôm nay bọn tao ngủ lại bên kia.”
translations.en: "You go on home now. We're staying over there tonight."
translations.zh-Hans: “你回去吧。我们今天要在那边住。”
translations.zh-Hant: “你回去吧。我們今天要在那邊住。”
translations.ko: “너는 이제 돌아가라. 우리는 오늘 저쪽에서 묵으니까.”
translations.tl: "Umuwi ka na. Doon kami matutulog ngayong gabi."
translations.ne: "तँ अब घर जा। हामी आज उतै बस्छौं।"
translations.id: "Kau pulanglah. Kami hari ini menginap di sana."
translations.pt: "Volte para casa agora. Hoje nós dormimos lá adiante."
translations.th: "เจ้ากลับไปได้แล้ว วันนี้พวกข้าค้างที่โน่น"
translations.si: "උඹ දැන් ගෙදර පලයන්. අපි අද එහේ නවතිනවා."

grammarNote.vi: 帰んな = về đi (帰りな, khẩu ngữ).
grammarNote.en: 帰んな = go home (casual 帰りな).
grammarNote.my: 帰んな = ပြန်တော့။
grammarNote.th: 帰んな = กลับไปเถอะ
grammarNote.si: 帰んな = ගෙදර පලයන් (අවිධිමත් 帰りな).

sentences.ja: 「あんまり帰りがおそくなると、われの家でも心配するずら。」

furigana.surface: りがおそくなると、われの

sentences.romaji: “Anmari kaeri ga osoku naru to, ware no ie de mo shinpaisuru zura.”

translations.vi: “Về muộn quá thì nhà mày cũng lo đấy.”
translations.en: "If you get home too late, your folks will worry too."
translations.zh-Hans: “回去太晚的话，你家里也会担心的。”
translations.zh-Hant: “回去太晚的話，你家裡也會擔心的。”
translations.ko: “너무 늦게 돌아가면 너희 집에서도 걱정할 거다.”
translations.tl: "Kapag gabing-gabi ka na umuwi, mag-aalala ang pamilya mo."
translations.ne: "धेरै ढिलो फर्किस् भने तेरो घरमा पनि चिन्ता गर्छन्।"
translations.id: "Kalau pulang terlalu malam, keluargamu pasti khawatir."
translations.pt: "Se voltar muito tarde, sua família vai se preocupar."
translations.my: "အရမ်းနောက်ကျမှ ပြန်ရင် မင်းအိမ်ကလည်း စိတ်ပူလိမ့်မယ်။"
translations.th: "ถ้ากลับดึกเกินไป ที่บ้านเจ้าก็จะเป็นห่วง"
translations.si: "ගොඩක් පරක්කු වුණොත්, උඹේ ගෙදරත් කලබල වෙයි."

grammarNote.vi: ずら = chắc là ~ (giọng địa phương).
grammarNote.my: ずら = ~ လိမ့်မယ် (ဒေသစကား)။
grammarNote.th: ずら = คงจะ (ภาษาถิ่น)

sentences.ja: 良平は、一瞬、ぽかんとしてしまいました。

furigana.surface: 、ぽかんとしてしまいました。

sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, isshun, pokanto shiteshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Trong một thoáng, Ryōhei đứng ngây ra.
translations.en: For a moment, Ryōhei was dumbfounded.
translations.zh-Hans: 那一瞬间，良平呆住了。
translations.zh-Hant: 那一瞬間，良平呆住了。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 한순간 멍해지고 말았습니다.
translations.tl: Sandaling natulala si Ryōhei.
translations.ne: एकछिन र्योहेई अक्क न बक्क भयो।
translations.id: Sesaat Ryōhei melongo.
translations.pt: Por um instante, Ryōhei ficou sem reação.
translations.my: ခဏတာ ရျိုဟေး ကြောင်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: ชั่วขณะหนึ่ง เรียวเฮยืนอึ้งไป
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, මොහොතකට, කට ඇරගෙන ගල් ගැසුණේය.

grammarNote.ne: ぽかんと = अक्क न बक्क।
grammarNote.my: ぽかんと = ကြောင်။
grammarNote.th: ぽかんと = อึ้ง
grammarNote.si: ぽかんと = කට ඇරගෙන, හිස්ව.

sentences.ja: もうすぐ暗くなる、そして家はずっと遠くだ、と良平は気がつきました。
sentences.romaji: Mousugu kuraku naru, soshite ie wa zutto tooku da, to Ryouhei wa ki ga tsukimashita.

translations.vi: Trời sắp tối, mà nhà thì còn xa lắm, Ryōhei chợt hiểu ra.
translations.en: It would soon be dark, and home was far away, Ryōhei realized.
translations.zh-Hans: 天快黑了，而家还很远，良平这才意识到。
translations.zh-Hant: 天快黑了，而家還很遠，良平這才意識到。
translations.ko: 곧 어두워지고 집은 아주 멀다는 것을 료헤이는 깨달았습니다.
translations.tl: Malapit nang dumilim, at malayo pa ang bahay, napagtanto ni Ryōhei.
translations.ne: छिट्टै अँध्यारो हुन्छ, घर धेरै टाढा छ भन्ने र्योहेईले थाहा पायो।
translations.id: Sebentar lagi gelap, dan rumah masih jauh, Ryōhei tersadar.
translations.pt: Logo ia escurecer, e a casa estava longe, percebeu Ryōhei.
translations.my: မကြာခင် မှောင်တော့မယ်၊ အိမ်က အဝေးကြီးမှာ ဆိုတာ ရျိုဟေး သတိထားမိတယ်။
translations.th: อีกไม่นานจะมืด และบ้านก็ยังอยู่ไกล เรียวเฮเพิ่งรู้ตัว
translations.si: ඉක්මනින් අඳුරු වෙනවා, ගෙදර ගොඩක් ඈතයි, කියා රියෝහෙයිට වැටහුණි.

grammarNote.my: もうすぐ = မကြာခင်။
grammarNote.th: もうすぐ = อีกไม่นาน

sentences.ja: 良平は、泣きそうになるのをがまんして、二人にぺこりとおじぎをしました。

furigana.surface: きそうになるのをがまんして、
にぺこりとおじぎをしました。

sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, nakisou ni naru no o gamanshite, futari ni pekorito ojigi o shimashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei cố nén để khỏi khóc, khẽ cúi chào hai người.
translations.en: Holding back tears, Ryōhei gave the two a quick bow.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平强忍着眼泪，向两人鞠了一躬。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平強忍著眼淚，向兩人鞠了一躬。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 울음이 나오려는 것을 참고 두 사람에게 꾸벅 인사했습니다.
translations.tl: Pinipigilan ang luha, mabilis na yumuko si Ryōhei sa dalawa.
translations.ne: र्योहेईले रुन लागेको थामेर दुवैलाई झुकेर नमस्कार गर्‍यो।
translations.id: Menahan tangis, Ryōhei membungkuk kecil kepada keduanya.
translations.pt: Contendo o choro, Ryōhei fez uma rápida reverência aos dois.
translations.th: เรียวเฮกลั้นน้ำตาไว้ แล้วโค้งให้ทั้งสองคน
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, අඬන්නට එන එක ඉවසාගෙන, දෙදෙනාට ඉක්මනින් හිස නමා ආචාර කළේය.

grammarNote.my: 〜そうになる = ~ လုနီး။
grammarNote.th: 〜そうになる = เกือบจะ ~

sentences.ja: そして、線路にそって、いっしょうけんめい走りだしました。

furigana.surface: にそって、いっしょうけんめい

sentences.romaji: Soshite, senro ni sotte, isshoukenmei hashiridashimashita.

translations.vi: Rồi cậu men theo đường ray, chạy hết sức mình.
translations.en: Then he began running along the tracks with all his might.
translations.zh-Hans: 然后，他沿着铁轨拼命地跑了起来。
translations.zh-Hant: 然後，他沿著鐵軌拼命地跑了起來。
translations.ko: 그리고 선로를 따라 열심히 달리기 시작했습니다.
translations.tl: Pagkatapos, tumakbo siya nang buong sikap sa tabi ng riles.
translations.ne: अनि रेलको लिकै लिक जी-जानले दौडन थाल्यो।
translations.id: Lalu ia berlari sekuat tenaga menyusuri rel.
translations.pt: E então correu com todas as forças ao longo dos trilhos.
translations.th: แล้วเขาก็วิ่งเลียบรางรถไฟสุดกำลัง
translations.si: ඉන්පසු, රේල් පාර දිගේ, මුළු හයියෙන් දුවන්නට පටන් ගත්තේය.

grammarNote.my: 〜にそって = ~ အတိုင်း။
grammarNote.th: 〜にそって = เลียบ ~

sentences.ja: おかしの包みはじゃまなので、道ばたへ放り出しました。
sentences.romaji: Okashi no tsutsumi wa jama na node, michibata e houridashimashita.

translations.vi: Gói bánh vướng víu nên cậu quăng nó ra bên đường.
translations.en: The packet of sweets was in the way, so he flung it by the roadside.
translations.zh-Hans: 点心包碍事，他就把它扔到了路边。
translations.zh-Hant: 點心包礙事，他就把它扔到了路邊。
translations.ko: 과자 꾸러미가 거추장스러워 길가로 내던졌습니다.
translations.tl: Nakaaabala ang balot ng matamis kaya inihagis niya ito sa gilid ng daan.
translations.ne: मिठाईको पोको अप्ठ्यारो भएकाले बाटोछेउ फ्याँकिदियो।
translations.id: Bungkusan kue itu mengganggu, jadi ia melemparnya ke pinggir jalan.
translations.pt: O embrulho de doces atrapalhava, então ele o jogou à beira do caminho.
translations.my: မုန့်ထုပ်က အနှောင့်အယှက်ဖြစ်လို့ လမ်းဘေးကို ပစ်ထုတ်လိုက်တယ်။
translations.th: ห่อขนมเกะกะ เขาจึงโยนทิ้งข้างทาง
translations.si: රසකැවිලි පොදිය බාධාවක් නිසා, පාර අයිනට විසි කළේය.

grammarNote.my: じゃま = အနှောင့်အယှက်။
grammarNote.th: じゃま = เกะกะ

sentences.ja: 走りにくい草履も、とうとうぬぎすててしまいました。

furigana.surface: も、とうとうぬぎすててしまいました。

sentences.romaji: Hashirinikui zouri mo, toutou nugisuteteshimaimashita.

translations.vi: Đôi dép rơm khó chạy, rốt cuộc cậu cũng tháo vứt đi.
translations.en: Finally he kicked off the straw sandals that were hard to run in.
translations.zh-Hans: 不好跑的草鞋，最后也脱下来扔掉了。
translations.zh-Hant: 不好跑的草鞋，最後也脫下來扔掉了。
translations.ko: 달리기 힘든 짚신도 결국 벗어 던져 버렸습니다.
translations.tl: Hinubad at itinapon na rin niya ang sandalyas na dayaming mahirap takbuhan.
translations.ne: दौडन गाह्रो हुने पराल चप्पल पनि अन्ततः फुकालेर फ्याँकिदियो।
translations.id: Sandal jerami yang menyulitkan lari pun akhirnya ia lepas dan buang.
translations.pt: As sandálias de palha, ruins para correr, ele acabou tirando e jogando fora.
translations.my: ပြေးရခက်တဲ့ ကောက်ရိုးဖိနပ်ကိုလည်း နောက်ဆုံး ချွတ်ပစ်လိုက်တယ်။
translations.th: รองเท้าฟางที่วิ่งลำบาก ในที่สุดเขาก็ถอดทิ้ง
translations.si: දුවන්නට අපහසු පිදුරු සෙරෙප්පුවත්, අවසානයේ ගලවා විසි කළේය.

meanings.my: ကောက်ရိုးဖိနပ်
meanings.th: รองเท้าฟาง

grammarNote.my: 〜にくい = ~ ရခက်။
grammarNote.th: 〜にくい = ~ ยาก

sentences.ja: 足のうらに小石がささっても、良平は止まりませんでした。
sentences.romaji: Ashi no ura ni koishi ga sasatte mo, Ryouhei wa tomarimasendeshita.

translations.vi: Sỏi đâm vào gan bàn chân, Ryōhei vẫn không dừng lại.
translations.en: Even when pebbles pierced the soles of his feet, Ryōhei didn't stop.
translations.zh-Hans: 即使小石子扎进脚底，良平也没有停下。
translations.zh-Hant: 即使小石子扎進腳底，良平也沒有停下。
translations.ko: 발바닥에 자갈이 박혀도 료헤이는 멈추지 않았습니다.
translations.tl: Kahit tinusok ng maliliit na bato ang talampakan niya, hindi huminto si Ryōhei.
translations.ne: खुट्टाको पैतालामा गिट्टी गढे पनि र्योहेई रोकिएन।
translations.id: Meski kerikil menusuk telapak kakinya, Ryōhei tak berhenti.
translations.pt: Mesmo com pedrinhas furando a sola dos pés, Ryōhei não parou.
translations.my: ခြေဖဝါးကို ကျောက်စရစ်တွေ စူးပေမဲ့ ရျိုဟေး မရပ်ဘူး။
translations.th: ถึงก้อนกรวดจะทิ่มฝ่าเท้า เรียวเฮก็ไม่หยุด
translations.si: යටි පතුලේ ගල් කැට ඇනුණත්, රියෝහෙයි නැවතුණේ නැත.

grammarNote.th: 〜ても = ถึงจะ ~

sentences.ja: 竹やぶのそばを走りぬけると、夕焼けの空も、もう消えかかっていました。
sentences.romaji: Takeyabu no soba o hashiri nukeru to, yuuyake no sora mo, mou kiekakatteimashita.

translations.vi: Chạy qua bụi tre, ráng chiều trên trời cũng sắp tắt.
translations.en: As he ran past the bamboo grove, the sunset glow was already fading.
translations.zh-Hans: 跑过竹林时，晚霞也快要消失了。
translations.zh-Hant: 跑過竹林時，晚霞也快要消失了。
translations.ko: 대숲 옆을 달려 지나자 저녁노을도 이미 사라져 가고 있었습니다.
translations.tl: Paglampas niya sa kawayanan, papawi na ang pamumula ng langit.
translations.ne: बाँसघारी छेउबाट दौडेर निस्कँदा साँझको लाली पनि हराउँदै थियो।
translations.id: Saat berlari melewati rumpun bambu, cahaya senja pun mulai padam.
translations.pt: Ao passar correndo pelo bambuzal, o arrebol já se apagava.
translations.my: ဝါးရုံဘေးက ပြေးဖြတ်လိုက်တော့ နေဝင်ရောင်လည်း ပျောက်လုနီး ဖြစ်နေပြီ။
translations.th: พอวิ่งผ่านกอไผ่ แสงตะวันยามเย็นก็ใกล้จะหายไปแล้ว
translations.si: උණ පඳුර අසලින් දිව ගිය විට, හිරු බැසීමේ අහසත්, දැනටමත් නිවී යමින් තිබුණි.

grammarNote.my: 〜かかる = ~ လုနီး။
grammarNote.th: 〜かかる = ใกล้จะ ~

sentences.ja: 良平は、命さえ助かればいいと思いながら、ただ走り続けました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, inochi sae tasukarebaii to omoinagara, tada hashiritsuzukemashita.

translations.vi: Ryōhei chỉ biết chạy mãi, nghĩ rằng chỉ cần giữ được mạng là đủ.
translations.en: Ryōhei just kept running, thinking only that he'd be fine as long as he survived.
translations.zh-Hans: 良平心想只要能保住命就好，一个劲地跑。
translations.zh-Hant: 良平心想只要能保住命就好，一個勁地跑。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 목숨만 건지면 된다고 생각하며 그저 계속 달렸습니다.
translations.tl: Patuloy lang tumakbo si Ryōhei, iniisip na basta't makaligtas siya.
translations.ne: र्योहेई ज्यान मात्र बचे पुग्छ भन्ने सोच्दै दौडिरह्यो।
translations.id: Ryōhei terus berlari, berpikir asal nyawanya selamat.
translations.pt: Ryōhei só continuou correndo, pensando que bastava sobreviver.
translations.my: ရျိုဟေး အသက်ပဲ လွတ်ရင်ရပြီလို့ တွေးရင်း ပြေးနေခဲ့တယ်။
translations.th: เรียวเฮวิ่งต่อไปเรื่อยๆ คิดว่าขอแค่รอดชีวิตก็พอ
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, ජීවිතය බේරුණා නම් ඇතැයි පමණක් සිතමින්, නොනවත්වා දිව්වේය.

meanings.en: be saved, be a big help
meanings.th: ช่วยได้มาก

grammarNote.vi: 〜さえ〜ばいい = chỉ cần ~ là được.
grammarNote.en: 〜さえ〜ばいい = all that matters is ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜さえ〜ばいい = ~ သာ ~ ရင်ရပြီ။
grammarNote.th: 〜さえ〜ばいい = ขอแค่ ~ ก็พอ

sentences.ja: 村の明かりが見えた時、良平は、思わず大声で泣き出しそうになりました。
sentences.romaji: Mura no akari ga mieta toki, Ryouhei wa, omowazu oogoe de nakidashisou ni narimashita.

translations.vi: Khi thấy ánh đèn trong làng, Ryōhei suýt òa khóc.
translations.en: When he saw the village lights, Ryōhei almost burst out crying.
translations.zh-Hans: 看见村子的灯光时，良平差点放声大哭。
translations.zh-Hant: 看見村子的燈光時，良平差點放聲大哭。
translations.ko: 마을 불빛이 보였을 때 료헤이는 저도 모르게 큰 소리로 울 뻔했습니다.
translations.tl: Nang matanaw ang ilaw ng nayon, muntik nang humagulgol si Ryōhei.
translations.ne: गाउँको बत्ती देख्दा र्योहेई ठूलो स्वरले रुन लागेको थियो।
translations.id: Saat melihat cahaya desa, Ryōhei hampir menangis keras.
translations.pt: Ao ver as luzes da vila, Ryōhei quase caiu no choro.
translations.my: ရွာမီးရောင်ကို မြင်တော့ ရျိုဟေး အသံကျယ်ကျယ်နဲ့ ငိုချလုနီး ဖြစ်သွားတယ်။
translations.th: พอเห็นแสงไฟหมู่บ้าน เรียวเฮเกือบร้องไห้โฮออกมา
translations.si: ගමේ එළි පෙනුණු විට, රියෝහෙයිට, නොදැනීම මහ හඬින් අඬන්නට එන්නට විය.

meanings.my: မရည်ရွယ်ဘဲ
meanings.th: โดยไม่รู้ตัว

grammarNote.en: 泣き出す = to burst into tears.
grammarNote.pt: 泣き出す = cair no choro.
grammarNote.my: 泣き出す = ငိုချ။
grammarNote.th: 泣き出す = ร้องไห้ออกมา
grammarNote.si: 泣き出す = අඬන්න පටන් ගන්නවා.

sentences.ja: 家の門口にかけこむと、良平は、とうとう大声で泣き出しました。
sentences.romaji: Ie no kadoguchi ni kakekomu to, Ryouhei wa, toutou oogoe de nakidashimashita.

translations.vi: Lao vào cổng nhà, cuối cùng Ryōhei òa khóc nức nở.
translations.en: Rushing through the gate of his house, Ryōhei finally burst out wailing.
translations.zh-Hans: 一冲进家门，良平终于放声大哭起来。
translations.zh-Hant: 一衝進家門，良平終於放聲大哭起來。
translations.ko: 집 대문으로 뛰어들자 료헤이는 마침내 큰 소리로 울음을 터뜨렸습니다.
translations.tl: Pagpasok niya sa tarangkahan ng bahay, tuluyang humagulgol si Ryōhei.
translations.ne: घरको ढोकामा दौडेर पस्नासाथ र्योहेई अन्ततः ठूलो स्वरले रोयो।
translations.id: Begitu masuk gerbang rumah, Ryōhei akhirnya menangis keras.
translations.pt: Ao entrar correndo pelo portão de casa, Ryōhei finalmente desatou a chorar.
translations.my: အိမ်တံခါးဝကို ပြေးဝင်လိုက်တာနဲ့ ရျိုဟေး နောက်ဆုံးတော့ အသံကျယ်ကျယ်နဲ့ ငိုချတော့တယ်။
translations.th: พอวิ่งเข้าประตูบ้าน เรียวเฮก็ร้องไห้โฮออกมาในที่สุด
translations.si: ගෙදර දොරටුවෙන් දිව ගිය විට, රියෝහෙයි, අවසානයේ මහ හඬින් අඬන්නට පටන් ගත්තේය.

grammarNote.vi: かけこむ = chạy ùa vào.
grammarNote.en: かけこむ = to rush in.
grammarNote.my: かけこむ = ပြေးဝင်။
grammarNote.th: かけこむ = วิ่งเข้าไป
grammarNote.si: かけこむ = දුවගෙන ඇතුළට යනවා.

sentences.ja: 「良平、どうしたの。こんなにおそくまで、どこへ行っていたの。」

furigana.surface: 、どうしたの。こんなにおそくまで、どこへ

sentences.romaji: “Ryouhei, dou shita no. Konnani osoku made, doko e itteita no.”

translations.vi: “Ryōhei, con sao thế? Đi đâu mà về muộn thế này?”
translations.en: "Ryōhei, what happened? Where have you been so late?"
translations.zh-Hans: “良平，怎么了？这么晚了，你到哪儿去了？”
translations.zh-Hant: “良平，怎麼了？這麼晚了，你到哪兒去了？”
translations.ko: “료헤이, 무슨 일이니? 이렇게 늦게까지 어디 갔었어?”
translations.tl: "Ryōhei, anong nangyari? Saan ka nagpunta at gabing-gabi na?"
translations.ne: "र्योहेई, के भयो? यति ढिलोसम्म कहाँ गएको थिइस्?"
translations.id: "Ryōhei, ada apa? Ke mana saja kamu sampai larut begini?"
translations.pt: "Ryōhei, o que houve? Onde você esteve até tão tarde?"
translations.my: "ရျိုဟေး၊ ဘာဖြစ်တာလဲ။ ဒီလောက်နောက်ကျတဲ့အထိ ဘယ်သွားနေတာလဲ။"
translations.th: "เรียวเฮ เป็นอะไรไป ไปไหนมาจนดึกขนาดนี้"
translations.si: "රියෝහෙයි, මොකද වුණේ? මෙච්චර රෑ වෙනකම්, කොහෙද ගියේ?"

grammarNote.th: 〜の？ = คำถามแบบเป็นกันเอง

sentences.ja: 母や近所の人たちが集まってきて、いろいろ声をかけてくれました。
sentences.romaji: Haha ya kinjo no hitotachi ga atsumattekite, iroiro koe o kaketekuremashita.

translations.vi: Mẹ và hàng xóm kéo đến, ai cũng hỏi han cậu.
translations.en: His mother and the neighbors gathered and spoke to him in many ways.
translations.zh-Hans: 母亲和邻居们都围了过来，七嘴八舌地问他。
translations.zh-Hant: 母親和鄰居們都圍了過來，七嘴八舌地問他。
translations.ko: 어머니와 이웃 사람들이 모여들어 이것저것 말을 걸어 주었습니다.
translations.tl: Nagtipon ang ina at mga kapitbahay at sari-saring tanong ang ibinigay sa kanya.
translations.ne: आमा र छिमेकीहरू जम्मा भएर थरीथरी कुरा सोधे।
translations.id: Ibu dan para tetangga berkumpul dan menyapanya macam-macam.
translations.pt: A mãe e os vizinhos se juntaram e lhe falaram de mil maneiras.
translations.th: แม่และเพื่อนบ้านมารวมตัวกัน ถามไถ่เขาต่างๆ นานา
translations.si: අම්මා සහ අසල්වැසියන් එකතු වී, නොයෙක් දේ කියමින් කතා කළහ.

grammarNote.vi: 声をかける = hỏi han, bắt chuyện.
grammarNote.en: 声をかける = to speak to.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 声をかける＝打招呼、搭话。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 聲をかける＝打招呼、搭話。
grammarNote.pt: 声をかける = dirigir a palavra.
grammarNote.my: 声をかける = စကားပြော။
grammarNote.th: 声をかける = ทัก

sentences.ja: けれども、良平は、何を言われても、ただわあわあ泣き続けるばかりでした。

furigana.surface: われても、ただわあわあ

sentences.romaji: Keredomo, Ryouhei wa, nani o iwarete mo, tada waawaa nakitsuzukeru bakari deshita.

translations.vi: Nhưng hỏi gì thì hỏi, Ryōhei chỉ biết khóc òa mãi.
translations.en: But whatever they said, Ryōhei just kept bawling.
translations.zh-Hans: 可是，不管别人说什么，良平只是哇哇地哭个不停。
translations.zh-Hant: 可是，不管別人說什麼，良平只是哇哇地哭個不停。
translations.ko: 그러나 료헤이는 무슨 말을 들어도 그저 엉엉 울기만 했습니다.
translations.tl: Ngunit anuman ang sabihin nila, patuloy lang sa pag-iyak si Ryōhei.
translations.ne: तर जे भने पनि र्योहेई भने ह्वाँ-ह्वाँ रोइरह्यो।
translations.id: Namun, apa pun yang dikatakan, Ryōhei hanya terus menangis meraung.
translations.pt: Mas, dissessem o que dissessem, Ryōhei só chorava sem parar.
translations.th: แต่ไม่ว่าใครจะพูดอะไร เรียวเฮก็ได้แต่ร้องไห้โฮไม่หยุด
translations.si: එහෙත්, රියෝහෙයි, කුමක් කිව්වත්, නොනවත්වා කෑ ගසා ඇඬුවා පමණි.

grammarNote.my: 〜ばかり = ~ ရုံပဲ။
grammarNote.th: 〜ばかり = แต่ ~

sentences.ja: あの長い道を走って帰った心細さは、とても言葉にはできなかったのです。

furigana.surface: にはできなかったのです。

sentences.romaji: Ano nagai michi o hashitte kaetta kokorobososa wa, totemo kotoba ni wa dekinakatta no desu.

translations.vi: Nỗi cô đơn trơ trọi khi chạy về trên con đường dài ấy, cậu không thể nói thành lời.
translations.en: The loneliness of running home down that long road was beyond words.
translations.zh-Hans: 在那条长路上跑回家时的那种无助，根本无法用言语表达。
translations.zh-Hant: 在那條長路上跑回家時的那種無助，根本無法用言語表達。
translations.ko: 그 긴 길을 달려서 돌아온 막막함은 도저히 말로 할 수 없었던 것입니다.
translations.tl: Ang pangungulila habang tumatakbo pauwi sa mahabang daang iyon ay hindi maipahayag sa salita.
translations.ne: त्यो लामो बाटो दौडेर फर्किँदाको एक्लोपन शब्दमा भन्न सकिँदैनथ्यो।
translations.id: Rasa sepi saat berlari pulang di jalan panjang itu sungguh tak terlukiskan.
translations.pt: A angústia de voltar correndo por aquela longa estrada não cabia em palavras.
translations.my: အဲဒီလမ်းရှည်ကြီးကို ပြေးပြန်လာရတဲ့ အထီးကျန်မှုကို စကားနဲ့ ပြောမပြနိုင်ခဲ့ဘူး။
translations.th: ความว้าเหว่ตอนวิ่งกลับบ้านบนถนนยาวเส้นนั้น ไม่อาจพูดออกมาเป็นคำได้
translations.si: ඒ දිගු පාර දිගේ දුවගෙන ආ අසරණකම, කිසිසේත් වචනයට නැගිය නොහැකි විය.

grammarNote.vi: 心細さ = nỗi cô đơn, chơi vơi.
grammarNote.my: 心細さ = အထီးကျန်မှု။
grammarNote.th: 心細さ = ความว้าเหว่

sentences.ja: 良平は、二十六の年に、妻子といっしょに東京へ出てきました。
sentences.romaji: Ryouhei wa, nijuuroku no toshi ni, saishi to issho ni Toukyou e detekimashita.

translations.vi: Năm hai mươi sáu tuổi, Ryōhei cùng vợ con lên Tokyo.
translations.en: At twenty-six, Ryōhei came to Tokyo with his wife and child.
translations.zh-Hans: 二十六岁那年，良平带着妻儿来到了东京。
translations.zh-Hant: 二十六歲那年，良平帶著妻兒來到了東京。
translations.ko: 료헤이는 스물여섯 살 때 처자식과 함께 도쿄로 올라왔습니다.
translations.tl: Sa edad na dalawampu't anim, lumipat si Ryōhei sa Tokyo kasama ang mag-ina niya.
translations.ne: छब्बीस वर्षको हुँदा र्योहेई श्रीमती र बच्चासँग टोकियो आयो।
translations.id: Pada usia dua puluh enam, Ryōhei pindah ke Tokyo bersama istri dan anaknya.
translations.pt: Aos vinte e seis anos, Ryōhei veio para Tóquio com a esposa e o filho.
translations.my: အသက်နှစ်ဆယ့်ခြောက်နှစ်မှာ ရျိုဟေး မယားနဲ့ကလေးနဲ့အတူ တိုကျိုကို ရောက်လာတယ်။
translations.th: เมื่ออายุยี่สิบหก เรียวเฮย้ายมาโตเกียวพร้อมภรรยาและลูก
translations.si: රියෝහෙයි, අවුරුදු විසි හයේදී, බිරිඳ සහ දරුවා සමඟ තෝකියෝවට පැමිණියේය.

grammarNote.my: 妻子 = မယားနဲ့ကလေး။
grammarNote.th: 妻子 = ภรรยาและลูก

sentences.ja: 今は、ある雑誌社の二階で、毎日赤いペンを持って校正をしています。
sentences.romaji: Ima wa, aru zasshisha no nikai de, mainichi akai pen o motte kousei o shiteimasu.

translations.vi: Giờ đây, ngày ngày anh cầm bút đỏ sửa bản in trên tầng hai một tòa soạn tạp chí.
translations.en: Now, every day, he proofreads with a red pen on the second floor of a magazine publisher.
translations.zh-Hans: 如今，他每天在一家杂志社的二楼，拿着红笔做校对。
translations.zh-Hant: 如今，他每天在一家雜誌社的二樓，拿著紅筆做校對。
translations.ko: 지금은 어느 잡지사 2층에서 날마다 빨간 펜을 들고 교정을 보고 있습니다.
translations.tl: Ngayon, araw-araw siyang nagwawasto ng teksto gamit ang pulang panulat sa ikalawang palapag ng isang publikasyon.
translations.ne: अहिले ऊ एउटा पत्रिका कार्यालयको दोस्रो तलामा हरेक दिन रातो कलमले प्रुफ हेर्छ।
translations.id: Kini, setiap hari ia mengoreksi naskah dengan pena merah di lantai dua sebuah penerbit majalah.
translations.pt: Hoje, todos os dias, revisa provas com caneta vermelha no segundo andar de uma editora de revistas.
translations.my: အခု မဂ္ဂဇင်းတိုက်တစ်ခုရဲ့ ဒုတိယထပ်မှာ နေ့တိုင်း ဘောပင်နီကိုင်ပြီး စာပြင်နေတယ်။
translations.th: ตอนนี้เขาถือปากกาแดงตรวจปรู๊ฟทุกวันอยู่ที่ชั้นสองของสำนักพิมพ์นิตยสารแห่งหนึ่ง
translations.si: දැන්, එක්තරා සඟරා ප්‍රකාශන ආයතනයක දෙවන මහලේ, හැමදාම රතු පෑනක් අතැතිව සෝදුපත් බලයි.

grammarNote.my: 校正 = စာပြင်။
grammarNote.th: 校正 = ตรวจปรู๊ฟ

sentences.ja: それでも、何の理由もなく、ふとあの日のことを思い出すことがあります。
sentences.romaji: Soredemo, nani no riyuu mo naku, futo ano hi no koto o omoidasu koto ga arimasu.

translations.vi: Thế nhưng, chẳng vì lý do gì, đôi khi anh chợt nhớ lại ngày hôm ấy.
translations.en: And yet, for no reason at all, he sometimes suddenly remembers that day.
translations.zh-Hans: 然而，有时会毫无缘由地，忽然想起那一天的事。
translations.zh-Hant: 然而，有時會毫無緣由地，忽然想起那一天的事。
translations.ko: 그런데도 아무 이유 없이 문득 그날 일을 떠올릴 때가 있습니다.
translations.tl: Gayunman, kung minsan, walang dahilan, bigla niyang naaalala ang araw na iyon.
translations.ne: तैपनि कुनै कारणबिना कहिलेकाहीँ ऊ त्यो दिन अचानक सम्झन्छ।
translations.id: Meski begitu, tanpa alasan apa pun, kadang ia tiba-tiba teringat hari itu.
translations.pt: Ainda assim, sem motivo algum, às vezes ele se lembra de repente daquele dia.
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ ဘာအကြောင်းမှမရှိဘဲ တစ်ခါတလေ အဲဒီနေ့ကို ရုတ်တရက် သတိရမိတယ်။
translations.th: ถึงอย่างนั้น บางครั้งเขาก็นึกถึงวันนั้นขึ้นมาโดยไม่มีเหตุผล
translations.si: එසේ වුවත්, කිසිම හේතුවක් නැතිව, හදිසියේම ඒ දවස මතක් වන අවස්ථා තිබේ.

grammarNote.my: 〜ことがある = တစ်ခါတလေ ~။
grammarNote.th: 〜ことがある = บางครั้ง ~

sentences.ja: つかれた良平の前には、今でもやはりあの時のように、うす暗いやぶや坂のある道が、細く長く続いているのです。
sentences.romaji: Tsukareta Ryouhei no mae ni wa, ima demo yahari ano toki no you ni, usu kurai yabu ya saka no aru michi ga, hosoku nagaku tsuzuiteiru no desu.

translations.vi: Trước mắt người đàn ông mệt mỏi ấy, đến giờ vẫn như hồi đó, một con đường mờ tối với bụi rậm và những con dốc cứ kéo dài, mảnh và xa mãi.
translations.en: Before the weary Ryōhei, even now, just as on that day, a dim road of thickets and slopes stretches on, thin and endless.
translations.zh-Hans: 在疲惫的良平面前，至今仍像那时一样，一条有灌木丛和山坡的昏暗小路，细细长长地延伸着。
translations.zh-Hant: 在疲憊的良平面前，至今仍像那時一樣，一條有灌木叢和山坡的昏暗小路，細細長長地延伸著。
translations.ko: 지친 료헤이 앞에는 지금도 역시 그때처럼 어스레한 덤불과 비탈이 있는 길이 가늘고 길게 이어져 있는 것입니다.
translations.tl: Sa harap ng pagod na si Ryōhei, hanggang ngayon, gaya noon, umaabot ang madilim na daan ng mga palumpong at dalisdis, manipis at walang katapusan.
translations.ne: थाकेको र्योहेईको अगाडि अहिले पनि त्यो बेलाझैं झाडी र उकालो भएको धमिलो बाटो पातलो र लामो भएर फैलिरहेको छ।
translations.id: Di hadapan Ryōhei yang lelah, hingga kini, seperti dulu, jalan remang dengan semak dan tanjakan terbentang, tipis dan panjang.
translations.pt: Diante do cansado Ryōhei, ainda hoje, como naquele dia, uma estrada sombria de matagais e ladeiras se estende, estreita e longa.
translations.my: ပင်ပန်းနေတဲ့ ရျိုဟေးရှေ့မှာ အခုထိ အဲဒီတုန်းကလိုပဲ ချုံပုတ်တွေ၊ ဆင်ခြေလျှောတွေရှိတဲ့ မှိန်မှိန်လမ်းလေးက သေးသေးရှည်ရှည် ဆက်လျက်ရှိနေတယ်။
translations.th: ตรงหน้าเรียวเฮผู้เหนื่อยล้า แม้ทุกวันนี้ก็ยังเหมือนวันนั้น ถนนสลัวที่มีพุ่มไม้และทางลาดทอดยาวเรียวไปไม่สิ้นสุด
translations.si: වෙහෙසට පත් රියෝහෙයි ඉදිරියේ, අදටත් ඒ කාලයේ මෙන්ම, අඳුරු පඳුරු සහ බෑවුම් සහිත පාරක්, සිහින්ව දිගටම විහිදී යයි.
